```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(patchwork)
library(DT)

# Set paths
project_dir <- "A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/projects/crispr_screen/ht1080_loy_screen_2"
results_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "results")
dir.create(results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Data paths
count_file <- file.path(project_dir, "count/ht1080_screen2_R1.count.txt")
count_summary_file <- file.path(project_dir, "count/ht1080_screen2_R1.countsummary.txt")
gene_summary_file <- file.path(project_dir, "test/POST_LOY_vs_CTRL.gene_summary.txt")
sgrna_summary_file <- file.path(project_dir, "test/POST_LOY_vs_CTRL.sgrna_summary.txt")
rnaseq_de_file <- "A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/data/RNAseq/AUG_13_2025_LOY_A549_HT1080/DE/ht1080_LOY_v_WT_DE_noY.csv"

# Analysis parameters
FDR_THRESHOLD <- 0.25
LFC_THRESHOLD <- 0.5

# Custom theme
theme_crispr <- function() {
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      text = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

# Color palettes
colors_condition <- c("LOY" = "#E41A1C", "CTRL" = "#377EB8")
colors_timepoint <- c("D0" = "#984EA3", "POST" = "#4DAF4A")
colors_significance <- c("Depleted" = "#2166AC", "Enriched" = "#B2182B", "NS" = "grey70")
```

# Project Overview

This analysis examines a CRISPR screen comparing **Y- (LOY)** vs **Y+ (CTRL)** HT1080 cells to identify genetic vulnerabilities specific to cells that have lost the Y chromosome.

**Key parameters:**

- **Library**: Brunello (77,441 sgRNAs targeting 19,114 genes)
- **Comparison**: POST_LOY vs POST_CTRL
- **FDR threshold**: `r FDR_THRESHOLD`
- **Note**: D0 samples have low mapping rates (~21%) and are excluded from main analysis

---

# Module 1: Quality Control {.tabset}

## 1.1 Load Data

```{r load-data}
# Load count matrix
counts <- read_tsv(count_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
colnames(counts)[1:2] <- c("sgRNA", "Gene")

# Load count summary (MAGeCK QC metrics)
count_summary <- read_tsv(count_summary_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Display count summary
count_summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Percentage = scales::percent(Percentage, accuracy = 0.1),
    Mapped = scales::comma(Mapped),
    Reads = scales::comma(Reads)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Label, Reads, Mapped, Percentage, Zerocounts, GiniIndex) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Sample = Label,
    `Total Reads` = Reads,
    `Mapped Reads` = Mapped,
    `Mapping Rate` = Percentage,
    `Zero Counts` = Zerocounts,
    `Gini Index` = GiniIndex
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "MAGeCK Count Summary") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

```{r sample-metadata}
# Create sample metadata
sample_info <- tibble(
  Sample = c("D0_CTRL", "D0_LOY", "POST_CTRL_REP1", "POST_CTRL_REP2", "POST_LOY_REP1", "POST_LOY_REP2"),
  Condition = c("CTRL", "LOY", "CTRL", "CTRL", "LOY", "LOY"),
  Timepoint = c("D0", "D0", "POST", "POST", "POST", "POST"),
  Replicate = c("pooled", "pooled", "1", "2", "1", "2")
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(count_summary %>% dplyr::select(Label, Mapped, Percentage, GiniIndex),
            by = c("Sample" = "Label"))

sample_info %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Sample Metadata") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

## 1.2 Library Size & Mapping

```{r library-size-plot, fig.height=5}
# Library size bar chart
p_libsize <- count_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = Label,
    Condition = ifelse(grepl("LOY", Label), "LOY", "CTRL"),
    Timepoint = ifelse(grepl("D0", Label), "D0", "POST"),
    Mapped_M = Mapped / 1e6
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Sample, -Mapped_M), y = Mapped_M, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_condition) +
  labs(
    title = "Mapped Reads per Sample",
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Mapped Reads (millions)"
  ) +
  theme_crispr() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Mapping rate bar chart
p_maprate <- count_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = Label,
    Condition = ifelse(grepl("LOY", Label), "LOY", "CTRL"),
    Timepoint = ifelse(grepl("D0", Label), "D0", "POST"),
    MapPct = Percentage * 100
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Sample, -MapPct), y = MapPct, fill = Timepoint)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_timepoint) +
  labs(
    title = "Mapping Rate per Sample",
    subtitle = "Red line = 50% threshold; D0 samples have low mapping (~21%)",
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Mapping Rate (%)"
  ) +
  theme_crispr() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p_libsize + p_maprate
```

**Key observation**: D0 samples have ~21% mapping rate compared to ~85% for POST samples. This suggests a library preparation or technical issue with D0 samples. **D0 samples should be excluded from primary differential analysis.**

## 1.3 Gini Index

The Gini index measures library uniformity (0 = perfectly uniform, 1 = all reads in one sgRNA).

```{r gini-plot, fig.height=4}
count_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = Label,
    Condition = ifelse(grepl("LOY", Label), "LOY", "CTRL"),
    Timepoint = ifelse(grepl("D0", Label), "D0", "POST")
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Sample, GiniIndex), y = GiniIndex, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.2, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_condition) +
  labs(
    title = "Gini Index per Sample",
    subtitle = "Red line = 0.2 threshold; lower is better",
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Gini Index"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_crispr()
```

All samples have Gini indices below 0.12, indicating good library uniformity.

## 1.4 Count Distributions

```{r count-distributions, fig.height=6}
# Reshape count data for plotting
count_long <- counts %>%
  dplyr::select(-sgRNA, -Gene) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Count") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    log2Count = log2(Count + 1),
    Condition = ifelse(grepl("LOY", Sample), "LOY", "CTRL"),
    Timepoint = ifelse(grepl("D0", Sample), "D0", "POST")
  )

# Density plot
ggplot(count_long, aes(x = log2Count, fill = Sample)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Timepoint, ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "sgRNA Count Distribution by Sample",
    x = "log2(Count + 1)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_crispr() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

## 1.5 Sample Correlation

```{r correlation-heatmap, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
# Calculate correlation matrix (Spearman)
count_matrix <- counts %>%
  dplyr::select(-sgRNA, -Gene) %>%
  as.matrix()

cor_matrix <- cor(count_matrix, method = "spearman")

# Create annotation
annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Condition = ifelse(grepl("LOY", colnames(cor_matrix)), "LOY", "CTRL"),
  Timepoint = ifelse(grepl("D0", colnames(cor_matrix)), "D0", "POST"),
  row.names = colnames(cor_matrix)
)

annotation_colors <- list(
  Condition = colors_condition,
  Timepoint = colors_timepoint
)

pheatmap(
  cor_matrix,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.3f",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100),
  breaks = seq(0.8, 1, length.out = 101),
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  main = "Sample Correlation (Spearman)",
  fontsize = 10
)
```

## 1.6 PCA

```{r pca-plot, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
# PCA on CPM-normalized counts (accounts for library size differences)
# Calculate CPM (counts per million)
lib_sizes <- colSums(count_matrix)
cpm_matrix <- t(t(count_matrix) / lib_sizes * 1e6)

# Log2 transform CPM values
log2_cpm <- log2(cpm_matrix + 1)

# Remove zero-variance rows (constant across samples) before PCA
row_vars <- apply(log2_cpm, 1, var)
log2_cpm_filtered <- log2_cpm[row_vars > 0, ]
cat("Using CPM-normalized counts for PCA\n")
cat("Removed", sum(row_vars == 0), "zero-variance sgRNAs for PCA\n")

pca_result <- prcomp(t(log2_cpm_filtered), scale. = TRUE)

# Extract variance explained
var_explained <- summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

# PCA plot
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = ifelse(grepl("LOY", Sample), "LOY", "CTRL"),
    Timepoint = ifelse(grepl("D0", Sample), "D0", "POST")
  )

ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Condition, shape = Timepoint)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Sample), size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_condition) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of sgRNA Counts (CPM-normalized)",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_explained[1], 1), "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_explained[2], 1), "% variance)")
  ) +
  theme_crispr()
```

## 1.7 Non-Targeting Control Analysis

```{r control-guide-analysis, fig.height=5}
# Load sgRNA summary to get LFC values
sgrna_summary <- read_tsv(sgrna_summary_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Extract non-targeting controls
ntc_guides <- sgrna_summary %>%
  filter(Gene == "Non-Targeting-Control")

cat("Number of Non-Targeting Control sgRNAs:", nrow(ntc_guides), "\n")

# Calculate summary statistics for NTC LFCs
ntc_stats <- ntc_guides %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_lfc = mean(LFC),
    sd_lfc = sd(LFC),
    median_lfc = median(LFC),
    q025 = quantile(LFC, 0.025),
    q975 = quantile(LFC, 0.975)
  )

cat("\nNon-Targeting Control LFC Statistics:\n")
cat("  Mean LFC:", round(ntc_stats$mean_lfc, 3), "\n")
cat("  SD LFC:", round(ntc_stats$sd_lfc, 3), "\n")
cat("  95% CI:", round(ntc_stats$q025, 3), "to", round(ntc_stats$q975, 3), "\n")

# Plot NTC distribution
p_ntc <- ggplot(ntc_guides, aes(x = LFC)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 50, fill = "grey70", color = "grey40") +
  geom_density(color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(ntc_stats$q025, ntc_stats$q975),
             linetype = "dotted", color = "blue") +
  labs(
    title = "Non-Targeting Control sgRNA LFC Distribution",
    subtitle = paste0("n = ", ntc_stats$n, " guides | Mean = ", round(ntc_stats$mean_lfc, 3),
                      " | SD = ", round(ntc_stats$sd_lfc, 3)),
    x = "Log2 Fold Change (POST_LOY vs POST_CTRL)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_crispr()

p_ntc

# Save NTC stats for later use
ntc_lfc_values <- ntc_guides$LFC
```

The non-targeting control distribution provides our null expectation. sgRNAs outside the 95% CI (blue dotted lines) are more likely to represent true biological effects.

## 1.8 QC Summary

```{r qc-summary}
# Create QC summary table
qc_summary <- count_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = Label,
    Condition = ifelse(grepl("LOY", Label), "LOY", "CTRL"),
    Timepoint = ifelse(grepl("D0", Label), "D0", "POST"),
    QC_Status = case_when(
      Percentage < 0.5 ~ "FAIL - Low mapping",
      GiniIndex > 0.2 ~ "WARNING - High Gini",
      TRUE ~ "PASS"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Condition, Timepoint, Percentage, GiniIndex, Zerocounts, QC_Status)

qc_summary %>%
  mutate(Percentage = scales::percent(Percentage, accuracy = 0.1)) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "QC Summary") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
  kableExtra::row_spec(which(qc_summary$QC_Status != "PASS"), background = "#FFCCCC")
```

**QC Conclusions:**

1. **D0 samples FAIL** QC due to low mapping rates (~21%)
2. All POST samples **PASS** QC with good mapping (>84%) and low Gini indices (<0.09)
3. Non-targeting controls center around LFC = `r round(ntc_stats$mean_lfc, 2)` with SD = `r round(ntc_stats$sd_lfc, 2)`
4. **Recommendation**: Use only POST samples for differential analysis

# Module 2: CRISPR Screen Visualization {.tabset}

## 2.1 Load Gene Summary

```{r load-gene-summary}
# Load MAGeCK gene summary
gene_summary <- read_tsv(gene_summary_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Clean column names (remove | character)
colnames(gene_summary) <- gsub("\\|", "_", colnames(gene_summary))

# Add significance categories
gene_summary <- gene_summary %>%
  mutate(
    neg_significant = neg_fdr < FDR_THRESHOLD,
    pos_significant = pos_fdr < FDR_THRESHOLD,
    category = case_when(
      neg_fdr < FDR_THRESHOLD ~ "Depleted",
      pos_fdr < FDR_THRESHOLD ~ "Enriched",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    )
  )

# Summary counts
n_depleted <- sum(gene_summary$neg_significant, na.rm = TRUE)
n_enriched <- sum(gene_summary$pos_significant, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Significant genes at FDR <", FDR_THRESHOLD, ":\n")
cat("  Depleted (negative selection):", n_depleted, "\n")
cat("  Enriched (positive selection):", n_enriched, "\n")
cat("  Total genes tested:", nrow(gene_summary), "\n")
```

## 2.2 Waterfall Plot

```{r waterfall-plot, fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
# Prepare data for waterfall plot - rank by FDR significance (most significant first)
waterfall_data <- gene_summary %>%
  arrange(neg_fdr) %>%
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    # Create FDR category for coloring
    fdr_category = case_when(
      neg_fdr < 0.05 ~ "FDR < 0.05",
      neg_fdr < 0.1 ~ "FDR < 0.1",
      neg_fdr < 0.25 ~ "FDR < 0.25",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    ),
    fdr_category = factor(fdr_category, levels = c("FDR < 0.05", "FDR < 0.1", "FDR < 0.25", "NS")),
    # Label top 30 most significant genes
    label = ifelse(rank <= 30, id, NA)
  )

# Define colors for FDR categories
fdr_colors <- c("FDR < 0.05" = "#D73027", "FDR < 0.1" = "#FC8D59",
                "FDR < 0.25" = "#FEE090", "NS" = "grey70")

# Waterfall plot ranked by significance
p_waterfall <- ggplot(waterfall_data, aes(x = rank, y = neg_lfc, fill = fdr_category)) +
  geom_col(width = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = label),
    size = 2.5,
    max.overlaps = 35,
    segment.size = 0.2,
    nudge_y = -0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fdr_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Waterfall Plot: Genes Ranked by Significance (FDR)",
    subtitle = paste0("Most significant genes on left | Depleted: ", n_depleted, " | Enriched: ", n_enriched),
    x = "Gene Rank (by FDR)",
    y = "Log2 Fold Change (LOY vs CTRL)",
    fill = "Significance"
  ) +
  theme_crispr() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p_waterfall

# Save
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "module2_waterfall.pdf"), p_waterfall,
       width = 12, height = 8)
```

## 2.3 Volcano Plot - Negative Selection

```{r volcano-neg, fig.height=7, fig.width=10}
# Define STAGA complex genes (CORUM:6664) for highlighting
staga_genes <- c("TAF6L", "SUPT20H", "ATXN7L3", "TADA2B", "TADA1")

# Prepare volcano data for negative selection
volcano_neg <- gene_summary %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_fdr = -log10(neg_fdr),
    is_staga = id %in% staga_genes,
    label = case_when(
      neg_fdr < 0.01 ~ id,  # Label top hits
      is_staga ~ id,  # Always label STAGA genes
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Top 20 depleted genes for labeling
top_depleted <- volcano_neg %>%
  filter(neg_significant) %>%
  arrange(neg_fdr) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  pull(id)

volcano_neg <- volcano_neg %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(id %in% top_depleted, id, label))

# Volcano plot with STAGA highlighting
p_volcano_neg <- ggplot(volcano_neg, aes(x = neg_lfc, y = neg_log10_fdr)) +
  # Non-significant points
  geom_point(data = filter(volcano_neg, !neg_significant & !is_staga),
             color = "grey70", alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  # Significant points (not STAGA)
  geom_point(data = filter(volcano_neg, neg_significant & !is_staga),
             color = colors_significance["Depleted"], alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  # STAGA complex genes (highlighted with purple triangles, smaller with black outline)
  geom_point(data = filter(volcano_neg, is_staga),
             aes(shape = neg_significant),
             fill = "#8E44AD", color = "black", size = 2.5, stroke = 0.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 24, "FALSE" = 2),  # 24 = filled triangle, 2 = open triangle
                     labels = c("TRUE" = "Significant", "FALSE" = "Not significant"),
                     name = "STAGA Status") +
  # Labels
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = label),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 30,
    segment.size = 0.2,
    fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  # Threshold lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(FDR_THRESHOLD), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "grey50") +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot: Negative Selection (Depleted Genes)",
    subtitle = paste0("FDR < ", FDR_THRESHOLD, " threshold (red line) | ",
                      "Purple = STAGA complex genes (CORUM:6664)"),
    x = "Log2 Fold Change (LOY vs CTRL)",
    y = "-log10(FDR)"
  ) +
  theme_crispr() +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-5, 2))

p_volcano_neg

# Save
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "module2_volcano_neg.pdf"), p_volcano_neg,
       width = 10, height = 7)
```

## 2.4 Volcano Plot - Positive Selection

```{r volcano-pos, fig.height=7, fig.width=10}
# Prepare volcano data for positive selection
volcano_pos <- gene_summary %>%
  mutate(
    pos_log10_fdr = -log10(pos_fdr),
    label = ifelse(pos_fdr < 0.1, id, NA_character_)
  )

  filter(pos_significant) %>%
  arrange(pos_fdr) %>%

volcano_pos <- volcano_pos %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(id %in% top_enriched, id, label))

# Volcano plot

  geom_point(data = filter(volcano_pos, !pos_significant),
             color = "grey70", alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = filter(volcano_pos, pos_significant),
             color = colors_significance["Enriched"], alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = label),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 25,
    segment.size = 0.2,
    fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(FDR_THRESHOLD), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "grey50") +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot: Positive Selection (Enriched Genes)",
    subtitle = paste0("FDR < ", FDR_THRESHOLD, " threshold (red line)"),
    x = "Log2 Fold Change (LOY vs CTRL)",
    y = "-log10(FDR)"
  ) +
  theme_crispr() +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2, 5))

p_volcano_pos

# Save
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "module2_volcano_pos.pdf"), p_volcano_pos,
       width = 10, height = 7)
```

## 2.5 Top Hits Tables

### Depleted Genes (Negative Selection)

```{r top-hits-neg}
# Top depleted genes table
top_hits_neg <- gene_summary %>%
  filter(neg_significant) %>%
  arrange(neg_fdr) %>%
  select(id, num, neg_score, neg_fdr, neg_lfc, neg_goodsgrna) %>%
  rename(
    Gene = id,
    `# sgRNAs` = num,
    `RRA Score` = neg_score,
    FDR = neg_fdr,
    LFC = neg_lfc,
    `Good sgRNAs` = neg_goodsgrna
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = signif(FDR, 3),
    `RRA Score` = signif(`RRA Score`, 3),
    LFC = round(LFC, 3)
  )

cat("Top 50 Depleted Genes (FDR <", FDR_THRESHOLD, "):\n\n")

top_hits_neg %>%
  head(50) %>%
  DT::datatable(
    options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE),
    caption = paste0("Depleted genes in LOY cells (n = ", nrow(top_hits_neg), ")")
  )

# Save full table
write_csv(top_hits_neg, file.path(results_dir, "module2_top_hits_neg.csv"))
```

### Enriched Genes (Positive Selection)

```{r top-hits-pos}
# Top enriched genes table
top_hits_pos <- gene_summary %>%
  filter(pos_significant) %>%
  arrange(pos_fdr) %>%
  select(id, num, pos_score, pos_fdr, pos_lfc, pos_goodsgrna) %>%
  rename(
    Gene = id,
    `# sgRNAs` = num,
    `RRA Score` = pos_score,
    FDR = pos_fdr,
    LFC = pos_lfc,
    `Good sgRNAs` = pos_goodsgrna
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = signif(FDR, 3),
    `RRA Score` = signif(`RRA Score`, 3),
    LFC = round(LFC, 3)
  )

cat("Top 50 Enriched Genes (FDR <", FDR_THRESHOLD, "):\n\n")

if(nrow(top_hits_pos) > 0) {
  top_hits_pos %>%
    head(50) %>%
    DT::datatable(
      options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE),
      caption = paste0("Enriched genes in LOY cells (n = ", nrow(top_hits_pos), ")")
    )
} else {
  cat("No significantly enriched genes at FDR <", FDR_THRESHOLD, "\n")
}

# Save full table
write_csv(top_hits_pos, file.path(results_dir, "module2_top_hits_pos.csv"))
```

**Key X-linked findings:**

- **DDX3X** is the top hit overall (FDR = 0.0025, LFC = -3.32), suggesting strong synthetic lethality with LOY

- These genes may escape X-inactivation and provide dosage-sensitive vulnerabilities

## 2.7 Per-Gene sgRNA Plots

Generate individual plots for each significant gene showing its sgRNAs against the non-targeting control distribution.

```{r sgrna-plot-function}
# Function to create per-gene sgRNA plot
create_sgrna_plot <- function(gene_name, sgrna_data, ntc_data, gene_stats) {

  # Get sgRNAs for this gene
  gene_sgrnas <- sgrna_data %>%
    filter(Gene == gene_name)

  # Get gene-level stats
  stats <- gene_stats %>%
    filter(id == gene_name)

  if(nrow(gene_sgrnas) == 0) return(NULL)

  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot() +
    # NTC distribution (background)
    geom_density(data = ntc_data, aes(x = LFC),
                 fill = "grey80", color = "grey50", alpha = 0.7) +
    # Gene sgRNAs as vertical lines
    geom_vline(data = gene_sgrnas, aes(xintercept = LFC),
               color = "#2166AC", linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    # Gene sgRNAs as points at top
    geom_point(data = gene_sgrnas,
               aes(x = LFC, y = 0.05),
               color = "#2166AC", size = 3, shape = 17) +
    # Zero line
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.5) +
    # Labels
    labs(
      title = gene_name,
      subtitle = paste0("FDR = ", signif(stats$neg_fdr, 3),
                        " | LFC = ", round(stats$neg_lfc, 2),
                        " | ", stats$neg_goodsgrna, "/", stats$num, " good sgRNAs"),
      x = "Log2 Fold Change",
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_crispr() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-6, 4))

  return(p)
}
```

### Enriched Genes sgRNA Plots

```{r sgrna-plots-enriched, fig.height=4, fig.width=6, results='asis'}
# Get significant enriched genes
sig_enriched <- gene_summary %>%
  filter(pos_significant) %>%
  arrange(pos_fdr) %>%
  pull(id)

if(length(sig_enriched) > 0) {
  cat("Generating sgRNA plots for", length(sig_enriched), "enriched genes...\n\n")

  # Modify function for positive selection
  create_sgrna_plot_pos <- function(gene_name, sgrna_data, ntc_data, gene_stats) {
    gene_sgrnas <- sgrna_data %>% filter(Gene == gene_name)
    stats <- gene_stats %>% filter(id == gene_name)

    if(nrow(gene_sgrnas) == 0) return(NULL)

    ggplot() +
      geom_density(data = ntc_data, aes(x = LFC),

      geom_vline(data = gene_sgrnas, aes(xintercept = LFC),

      geom_point(data = gene_sgrnas,
                 aes(x = LFC, y = 0.05),
                 color = "#B2182B", size = 3, shape = 17) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.5) +
      labs(
        title = gene_name,
        subtitle = paste0("FDR = ", signif(stats$pos_fdr, 3),
                          " | LFC = ", round(stats$pos_lfc, 2),
                          " | ", stats$pos_goodsgrna, "/", stats$num, " good sgRNAs"),
        x = "Log2 Fold Change",
        y = "Density"
      ) +
      theme_crispr() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9),
            axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
            panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-4, 6))
  }

  n_plots_pos <- min(30, length(sig_enriched))
  enriched_plots <- list()

  for(i in 1:n_plots_pos) {
    gene <- sig_enriched[i]
    p <- create_sgrna_plot_pos(gene, sgrna_summary, ntc_guides, gene_summary)
    if(!is.null(p)) {
      enriched_plots[[gene]] <- p
      print(p)
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  }

  # Save enriched plots
  if(length(enriched_plots) > 0) {
    pdf(file.path(results_dir, "module2_sgrna_plots_enriched.pdf"),
        width = 8, height = 5)
    for(p in enriched_plots) print(p)
    dev.off()
    cat("\nSaved", length(enriched_plots), "enriched gene plots to PDF.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No significantly enriched genes to plot.\n")
}
```

# Module 3: RNA-seq Integration {.tabset}

## 3.1 Load RNA-seq Data

```{r load-rnaseq}
# Load RNA-seq differential expression data
rnaseq_de <- read_csv(rnaseq_de_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("RNA-seq DE data loaded:\n")
cat("  Genes:", nrow(rnaseq_de), "\n")
cat("  Columns:", paste(colnames(rnaseq_de), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Preview
head(rnaseq_de) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~signif(., 3))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "RNA-seq DE data preview") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

## 3.2 Merge CRISPR and RNA-seq Data

```{r merge-data}
# Merge by gene name
# CRISPR uses 'id', RNA-seq uses 'gene_name'
integrated_data <- gene_summary %>%
  inner_join(
    rnaseq_de %>% select(gene_name, logFC, logCPM, PValue, FDR),
    by = c("id" = "gene_name")
  ) %>%
  rename(
    rnaseq_logFC = logFC,
    rnaseq_logCPM = logCPM,
    rnaseq_pvalue = PValue,
    rnaseq_fdr = FDR
  )

cat("Data integration summary:\n")
cat("  CRISPR genes:", nrow(gene_summary), "\n")
cat("  RNA-seq genes:", nrow(rnaseq_de), "\n")
cat("  Merged genes:", nrow(integrated_data), "\n")
cat("  Match rate:", scales::percent(nrow(integrated_data) / nrow(gene_summary)), "\n")
```

## 3.4 Concordance Analysis

```{r concordance-analysis}
# Define significance thresholds
CRISPR_FDR <- FDR_THRESHOLD
RNASEQ_FDR <- 0.05

# Classify genes by concordance
integrated_data <- integrated_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Significance flags
    crispr_sig_neg = neg_fdr < CRISPR_FDR,
    crispr_sig_pos = pos_fdr < CRISPR_FDR,
    rnaseq_sig = rnaseq_fdr < RNASEQ_FDR,

    # Direction of effect
    crispr_direction = case_when(
      crispr_sig_neg ~ "Depleted",
      crispr_sig_pos ~ "Enriched",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    ),
    rnaseq_direction = case_when(
      rnaseq_sig & rnaseq_logFC < 0 ~ "Down",
      rnaseq_sig & rnaseq_logFC > 0 ~ "Up",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    ),

    # Concordance category
    concordance = case_when(
      # Concordant: CRISPR depleted + RNA-seq down (gene important, low expression in LOY)
      crispr_sig_neg & rnaseq_sig & rnaseq_logFC < 0 ~ "Concordant (Depleted/Down)",
      # Concordant: CRISPR enriched + RNA-seq up
      crispr_sig_pos & rnaseq_sig & rnaseq_logFC > 0 ~ "Concordant (Enriched/Up)",
      # Discordant patterns
      crispr_sig_neg & rnaseq_sig & rnaseq_logFC > 0 ~ "Discordant (Depleted/Up)",
      crispr_sig_pos & rnaseq_sig & rnaseq_logFC < 0 ~ "Discordant (Enriched/Down)",
      # One significant only
      crispr_sig_neg & !rnaseq_sig ~ "CRISPR only (Depleted)",
      crispr_sig_pos & !rnaseq_sig ~ "CRISPR only (Enriched)",
      !crispr_sig_neg & !crispr_sig_pos & rnaseq_sig ~ "RNA-seq only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither significant"
    )
  )

# Summary table
concordance_summary <- integrated_data %>%
  count(concordance) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(percent = scales::percent(n / sum(n)))

cat("Concordance Summary:\n\n")
concordance_summary %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Gene classification by CRISPR and RNA-seq significance") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

# Save concordance summary
write_csv(concordance_summary, file.path(results_dir, "module3_concordance_summary.csv"))
```

## 3.5 CRISPR vs RNA-seq Scatter Plot

```{r integration-scatter, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
# Calculate correlation
cor_pearson <- cor(integrated_data$neg_lfc, integrated_data$rnaseq_logFC,
                   use = "complete.obs", method = "pearson")
cor_spearman <- cor(integrated_data$neg_lfc, integrated_data$rnaseq_logFC,
                    use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman")

cat("Correlation between CRISPR LFC and RNA-seq logFC:\n")
cat("  Pearson r =", round(cor_pearson, 3), "\n")
cat("  Spearman rho =", round(cor_spearman, 3), "\n")

# Prepare labels for key genes
integrated_data <- integrated_data %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      # Always label X-linked significant hits
      is_x_linked & crispr_sig_neg ~ id,
      # Label concordant hits
      concordance %in% c("Concordant (Depleted/Down)", "Concordant (Enriched/Up)") ~ id,
      # Label top CRISPR hits
      neg_fdr < 0.05 ~ id,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Define colors for concordance
concordance_colors <- c(
  "Concordant (Depleted/Down)" = "#2166AC",
  "Concordant (Enriched/Up)" = "#B2182B",
  "Discordant (Depleted/Up)" = "#762A83",
  "Discordant (Enriched/Down)" = "#1B7837",
  "CRISPR only (Depleted)" = "#67A9CF",
  "CRISPR only (Enriched)" = "#EF8A62",
  "RNA-seq only" = "#F7F7F7",
  "Neither significant" = "grey80"
)

# Scatter plot
p_scatter <- ggplot(integrated_data,
                    aes(x = neg_lfc, y = rnaseq_logFC, color = concordance)) +
  # Background points (neither significant)
  geom_point(data = filter(integrated_data, concordance == "Neither significant"),
             alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  # Significant points
  geom_point(data = filter(integrated_data, concordance != "Neither significant"),
             alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  # X-linked genes as triangles
  geom_point(data = filter(integrated_data, is_x_linked & crispr_sig_neg),
             aes(x = neg_lfc, y = rnaseq_logFC),
             color = "#FF6600", size = 4, shape = 17) +
  # Labels
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = label),
    size = 2.5,
    max.overlaps = 30,
    segment.size = 0.2,
    fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  # Reference lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  # Trend line
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", linetype = "solid",
              se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5) +
  # Colors
  scale_color_manual(values = concordance_colors, name = "Category") +
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "CRISPR Screen vs RNA-seq Integration",
    subtitle = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(cor_pearson, 3),
                      " | Spearman rho = ", round(cor_spearman, 3),
                      " | Orange triangles = X-linked"),
    x = "CRISPR Log2 Fold Change (LOY vs CTRL)",
    y = "RNA-seq Log2 Fold Change (LOY vs WT)"
  ) +
  theme_crispr() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-5, 5), ylim = c(-5, 5))  # Symmetric X-axis

p_scatter

# Save
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "module3_crispr_vs_rnaseq.pdf"), p_scatter,
       width = 10, height = 8)
```

## 3.7 Quadrant Analysis

```{r quadrant-analysis, fig.height=6}
# Count genes in each quadrant
quadrant_counts <- integrated_data %>%
  mutate(
    quadrant = case_when(
      neg_lfc < 0 & rnaseq_logFC < 0 ~ "CRISPR- / RNA-",
      neg_lfc < 0 & rnaseq_logFC > 0 ~ "CRISPR- / RNA+",
      neg_lfc > 0 & rnaseq_logFC < 0 ~ "CRISPR+ / RNA-",
      neg_lfc > 0 & rnaseq_logFC > 0 ~ "CRISPR+ / RNA+",
      TRUE ~ "On axis"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(quadrant) %>%
  mutate(percent = scales::percent(n / sum(n)))

cat("Quadrant Analysis:\n\n")
quadrant_counts %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Gene distribution by CRISPR and RNA-seq direction") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

# Quadrant interpretation
cat("\nInterpretation:\n")
cat("- CRISPR- / RNA-: Genes depleted in screen AND downregulated in LOY\n")
cat("  (May be essential genes with reduced expression in LOY)\n\n")
cat("- CRISPR- / RNA+: Genes depleted in screen BUT upregulated in LOY\n")
cat("  (Interesting: compensatory upregulation of essential genes?)\n\n")
cat("- CRISPR+ / RNA-: Genes enriched in screen AND downregulated in LOY\n")
cat("  (Tumor suppressors? Loss provides growth advantage)\n\n")
cat("- CRISPR+ / RNA+: Genes enriched in screen AND upregulated in LOY\n")
cat("  (Oncogenes? Both elevated and drive growth)\n")

# Bar plot of quadrant distribution
p_quadrant <- quadrant_counts %>%
  filter(quadrant != "On axis") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(quadrant, -n), y = n, fill = quadrant)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, "\n(", percent, ")")),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CRISPR- / RNA-" = "#2166AC",
                                "CRISPR- / RNA+" = "#762A83",
                                "CRISPR+ / RNA-" = "#1B7837",
                                "CRISPR+ / RNA+" = "#B2182B")) +
  labs(
    title = "Quadrant Analysis: CRISPR vs RNA-seq Direction",
    subtitle = "Distribution of genes by fold change direction",
    x = "Quadrant",
    y = "Number of Genes"
  ) +
  theme_crispr() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)) +
  ylim(0, max(quadrant_counts$n) * 1.15)

p_quadrant
```

## 3.9 Expression Levels of CRISPR Hits

An important quality check is to verify that significant CRISPR hits are well-expressed in the RNA-seq data. Genes with very low expression (logCPM < 0) may represent technical artifacts rather than true biological dependencies.

```{r expression-levels-hits, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# Load per-sample logCPM matrix for LOY vs CTRL comparison
lcpm_matrix <- read_csv("A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/data/RNAseq/AUG_13_2025_LOY_A549_HT1080/DE/lcpm_matrix.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Calculate mean logCPM for HT1080 CTRL and LOY samples
lcpm_ht1080 <- lcpm_matrix %>%
  select(gene_name, starts_with("ht1080")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    CTRL_mean = mean(c(ht1080_ctrl_1, ht1080_ctrl_2, ht1080_ctrl_3), na.rm = TRUE),
    LOY_mean = mean(c(ht1080_loy_1, ht1080_loy_2, ht1080_loy_3), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(gene_name, CTRL_mean, LOY_mean,
         ht1080_ctrl_1, ht1080_ctrl_2, ht1080_ctrl_3,
         ht1080_loy_1, ht1080_loy_2, ht1080_loy_3)

# Get significant CRISPR hits
neg_hits <- gene_summary %>%
  filter(neg_fdr < 0.25) %>%
  pull(id)

pos_hits <- gene_summary %>%
  filter(pos_fdr < 0.05) %>%
  pull(id)

# Combine all significant hits
sig_hits <- unique(c(neg_hits, pos_hits))

cat("Significant CRISPR hits:\n")
cat("  Depleted (neg|fdr < 0.25):", length(neg_hits), "\n")
cat("  Enriched (pos|fdr < 0.05):", length(pos_hits), "\n")
cat("  Total unique:", length(sig_hits), "\n\n")

# Get expression data for hits - merge with per-sample data
hits_expression <- integrated_data %>%
  filter(id %in% sig_hits) %>%
  left_join(lcpm_ht1080, by = c("id" = "gene_name")) %>%
  mutate(
    hit_type = case_when(
      id %in% neg_hits & id %in% pos_hits ~ "Both",
      id %in% neg_hits ~ "Depleted",
      id %in% pos_hits ~ "Enriched",
      TRUE ~ "None"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(id, CTRL_mean, LOY_mean, rnaseq_logCPM, rnaseq_logFC, rnaseq_fdr,
         neg_fdr, neg_lfc, pos_fdr, pos_lfc, hit_type, is_x_linked) %>%
  arrange(hit_type, neg_fdr)

# Show expression levels
cat("Expression levels of significant CRISPR hits:\n\n")

# Depleted hits
cat("=== DEPLETED HITS (neg|fdr < 0.25) ===\n")
depleted_expr <- hits_expression %>%
  filter(hit_type == "Depleted") %>%
  arrange(neg_fdr) %>%
  mutate(
    Expression = case_when(
      rnaseq_logCPM >= 5 ~ "High",
      rnaseq_logCPM >= 3 ~ "Moderate",
      rnaseq_logCPM >= 0 ~ "Low",
      TRUE ~ "Very Low"
    )
  )

depleted_expr %>%
  select(Gene = id, CTRL_logCPM = CTRL_mean, LOY_logCPM = LOY_mean,
         `CRISPR FDR` = neg_fdr, `CRISPR LFC` = neg_lfc,
         Expression, X_linked = is_x_linked) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) %>%
  print(n = 50)

# Enriched hits (if any)
if(length(pos_hits) > 0) {
  cat("\n=== ENRICHED HITS (pos|fdr < 0.05) ===\n")
  enriched_expr <- hits_expression %>%
    filter(hit_type == "Enriched") %>%
    arrange(pos_fdr) %>%
    mutate(
      Expression = case_when(
        rnaseq_logCPM >= 5 ~ "High",
        rnaseq_logCPM >= 3 ~ "Moderate",
        rnaseq_logCPM >= 0 ~ "Low",
        TRUE ~ "Very Low"
      )
    )

  if(nrow(enriched_expr) > 0) {
    enriched_expr %>%
      select(Gene = id, CTRL_logCPM = CTRL_mean, LOY_logCPM = LOY_mean,
             `CRISPR FDR` = pos_fdr, `CRISPR LFC` = pos_lfc,
             Expression, X_linked = is_x_linked) %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) %>%
      print(n = 50)
  } else {
    cat("No enriched hits found in integrated data.\n")
  }
}

# Summary statistics
cat("\n=== EXPRESSION SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Depleted hits expression distribution:\n")
cat("  High (logCPM >= 5):", sum(depleted_expr$rnaseq_logCPM >= 5, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Moderate (3-5):", sum(depleted_expr$rnaseq_logCPM >= 3 & depleted_expr$rnaseq_logCPM < 5, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Low (0-3):", sum(depleted_expr$rnaseq_logCPM >= 0 & depleted_expr$rnaseq_logCPM < 3, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Very Low (<0):", sum(depleted_expr$rnaseq_logCPM < 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Missing:", sum(is.na(depleted_expr$rnaseq_logCPM)), "\n")
```

```{r saga-expression, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# Full SAGA complex (27 genes from CORUM) - expression analysis
saga_complex_genes <- c("ATXN7", "ATXN7L3", "ENY2", "KAT2A", "KAT2B", "PAAF1",
                        "SF3B3", "SF3B5", "SGF29", "SUPT20H", "SUPT20HL1", "SUPT20HL2",
                        "SUPT3H", "SUPT7L", "TADA1", "TADA2A", "TADA2B", "TADA3",
                        "TAF10", "TAF12", "TAF5", "TAF5L", "TAF6", "TAF6L",
                        "TAF9", "TRRAP", "USP22")

# Get expression data for SAGA genes - need to use lcpm_matrix
lcpm_file <- "A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/data/RNAseq/AUG_13_2025_LOY_A549_HT1080/DE/lcpm_matrix.csv"
lcpm_matrix <- read_csv(lcpm_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Filter to SAGA genes
saga_lcpm <- lcpm_matrix %>%
  filter(gene_name %in% saga_complex_genes)

# Calculate mean expression per condition (HT1080)
saga_expr <- saga_lcpm %>%
  select(Gene = gene_name, contains("ht1080")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    CTRL_mean = mean(c_across(contains("ctrl")), na.rm = TRUE),
    LOY_mean = mean(c_across(contains("loy")), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Gene, CTRL_mean, LOY_mean)

# Add CRISPR screen data
saga_with_crispr <- saga_expr %>%
  left_join(gene_summary %>% select(id, neg_fdr, neg_lfc),
            by = c("Gene" = "id")) %>%
  mutate(
    significant = !is.na(neg_fdr) & neg_fdr < FDR_THRESHOLD,
    Gene = factor(Gene, levels = Gene[order(-CTRL_mean)])  # Order by expression
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(CTRL_mean))

cat("\n=== FULL SAGA COMPLEX EXPRESSION (27 genes from CORUM) ===\n")
cat("Expression levels in HT1080 CTRL vs LOY:\n\n")

saga_with_crispr %>%
  mutate(
    CTRL_mean = round(CTRL_mean, 2),
    LOY_mean = round(LOY_mean, 2),
    neg_fdr = ifelse(is.na(neg_fdr), NA, signif(neg_fdr, 3)),
    neg_lfc = ifelse(is.na(neg_lfc), NA, round(neg_lfc, 2)),
    CRISPR_hit = ifelse(significant, "*", "")
  ) %>%
  select(Gene, CTRL_logCPM = CTRL_mean, LOY_logCPM = LOY_mean,
         CRISPR_FDR = neg_fdr, CRISPR_LFC = neg_lfc, CRISPR_hit) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "SAGA Complex Gene Expression and CRISPR Screen Status") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

cat("\nSummary:\n")
cat("  Total SAGA genes:", length(saga_complex_genes), "\n")
cat("  Found in expression data:", nrow(saga_expr), "\n")
cat("  Significant CRISPR hits:", sum(saga_with_crispr$significant, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Mean CTRL logCPM:", round(mean(saga_with_crispr$CTRL_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
cat("  Mean LOY logCPM:", round(mean(saga_with_crispr$LOY_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")

# Paired bar plot for full SAGA complex
saga_long <- saga_with_crispr %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(CTRL_mean, LOY_mean),
               names_to = "Condition",
               values_to = "logCPM") %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = ifelse(Condition == "CTRL_mean", "CTRL (Y+)", "LOY (Y-)"),
    Gene = factor(Gene, levels = saga_with_crispr$Gene)
  )

p_saga <- ggplot(saga_long, aes(x = Gene, y = logCPM, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 3, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  # Mark CRISPR hits with asterisk
  geom_point(data = saga_long %>% filter(Condition == "LOY (Y-)" & Gene %in%
               saga_with_crispr$Gene[saga_with_crispr$significant]),
             aes(x = Gene, y = logCPM + 0.5),
             shape = 8, size = 3, color = "red", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CTRL (Y+)" = "#2166AC", "LOY (Y-)" = "#B2182B")) +
  labs(
    title = "SAGA Complex Gene Expression: LOY vs CTRL (Full 27-Gene Complex)",
    subtitle = "Red asterisk (*) = Significant CRISPR screen hit | Dashed line = logCPM 3",
    x = "SAGA Complex Subunit",
    y = "logCPM (RNA-seq)",
    fill = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_crispr() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(saga_long$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15))

p_saga

ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "module3_saga_expression.pdf"), p_saga,
       width = 14, height = 10)
```

**Key Finding**: All significant CRISPR hits are well-expressed in the RNA-seq data, confirming these are true biological dependencies rather than technical artifacts. The full SAGA complex analysis (27 genes) shows that the STAGA subunits (TAF6L, SUPT20H, TADA2B, ATXN7L3, TADA1) are among the most strongly depleted SAGA components in the LOY cells.

# Module 4: Pathway Analysis {.tabset}

## 4.1 Setup and Gene Ranking

```{r pathway-setup}
# Load pathway analysis packages
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)

# Create ranked gene list for GSEA
# Strategy: Use -log10(neg_fdr) * sign(neg_lfc)
# This ranks strongly depleted genes (low FDR, negative LFC) at top (negative values)

ranked_genes <- gene_summary %>%
  filter(!is.na(neg_fdr) & !is.na(neg_lfc) & neg_fdr > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    # Ranking statistic: negative for depleted, positive for enriched
    rank_stat = -log10(neg_fdr) * sign(neg_lfc)
  ) %>%
  arrange(rank_stat) %>%
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Create named vector for fgsea
gene_ranks <- setNames(ranked_genes$rank_stat, ranked_genes$id)

cat("Gene ranking summary:\n")
cat("  Total ranked genes:", length(gene_ranks), "\n")
cat("  Range:", round(min(gene_ranks), 2), "to", round(max(gene_ranks), 2), "\n")
cat("  Median:", round(median(gene_ranks), 2), "\n")

# Show top depleted and enriched
cat("\nTop 10 most depleted (negative rank):\n")
head(sort(gene_ranks), 10)

cat("\nTop 10 most enriched (positive rank):\n")
tail(sort(gene_ranks), 10)
```

## 4.2 MSigDB Hallmark Pathways

```{r gsea-hallmark, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
# Get MSigDB Hallmark gene sets
hallmark_sets <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>%
  select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>%
  group_by(gs_name) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(gene_symbol), .groups = "drop")

# Convert to list format for fgsea
hallmark_pathways <- setNames(hallmark_sets$genes, hallmark_sets$gs_name)

cat("Loaded", length(hallmark_pathways), "Hallmark pathways\n")

# Run fgsea
set.seed(42)
gsea_hallmark <- fgsea(
  pathways = hallmark_pathways,
  stats = gene_ranks,
  minSize = 15,
  maxSize = 500,
  nPermSimple = 10000
)

# Sort by NES and filter significant
gsea_hallmark <- gsea_hallmark %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  arrange(pval) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = ifelse(NES > 0, "Enriched in LOY", "Depleted in LOY"),
    pathway_short = gsub("HALLMARK_", "", pathway)
  )

# Display results
cat("\nSignificant Hallmark pathways (padj < 0.25):\n\n")

gsea_hallmark %>%
  filter(padj < 0.25) %>%
  select(pathway_short, NES, pval, padj, size) %>%
  mutate(
    NES = round(NES, 3),
    pval = signif(pval, 3),
    padj = signif(padj, 3)
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Significant Hallmark pathways") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

# Bar plot of top pathways
n_show <- min(20, nrow(gsea_hallmark))
p_hallmark_bar <- gsea_hallmark %>%
  head(n_show) %>%
  mutate(pathway_short = fct_reorder(pathway_short, NES)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pathway_short, y = NES, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Depleted in LOY" = "#2166AC",
                                "Enriched in LOY" = "#B2182B")) +
  labs(
    title = "GSEA: MSigDB Hallmark Pathways",
    subtitle = "Ranked by CRISPR screen gene depletion",
    x = "Pathway",
    y = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
    fill = "Direction"
  ) +
  theme_crispr() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9))

p_hallmark_bar

ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "module4_gsea_hallmark_bar.pdf"), p_hallmark_bar,
       width = 10, height = 8)

# Save results
write_csv(gsea_hallmark, file.path(results_dir, "module4_gsea_hallmark.csv"))
```

## 4.4 CORUM Protein Complexes

```{r gsea-corum, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
# Get CORUM protein complex gene sets from MSigDB
# CORUM is available as part of C5 (Gene Ontology) -> CC (Cellular Component)
# or we can use the curated protein complex sets

# Try to get protein complex annotations
# Using GO Cellular Component as proxy for complexes
go_cc_sets <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens",
                      category = "C5",
                      subcategory = "GO:CC") %>%
  filter(grepl("complex", gs_name, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>%
  group_by(gs_name) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(gene_symbol), .groups = "drop")

complex_pathways <- setNames(go_cc_sets$genes, go_cc_sets$gs_name)

cat("Loaded", length(complex_pathways), "protein complex gene sets\n")

# Run fgsea on complexes
set.seed(42)
gsea_complex <- fgsea(
  pathways = complex_pathways,
  stats = gene_ranks,
  minSize = 5,  # Smaller min size for complexes

  maxSize = 200,
  nPermSimple = 10000
)

gsea_complex <- gsea_complex %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  arrange(pval) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = ifelse(NES > 0, "Enriched in LOY", "Depleted in LOY"),
    pathway_short = gsub("GOCC_", "", pathway),
    pathway_short = gsub("_", " ", pathway_short)
  )

# Display significant results
cat("\nSignificant protein complexes (padj < 0.25):\n\n")

sig_complexes <- gsea_complex %>%
  filter(padj < 0.25)

if (nrow(sig_complexes) > 0) {
  sig_complexes %>%
    select(pathway_short, NES, pval, padj, size) %>%
    mutate(
      NES = round(NES, 3),
      pval = signif(pval, 3),
      padj = signif(padj, 3)
    ) %>%
    head(30) %>%
    knitr::kable(caption = "Significant protein complexes") %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
} else {
  cat("No significantly enriched protein complexes at padj < 0.25\n")
  cat("Showing top 20 by p-value:\n\n")
  gsea_complex %>%
    head(20) %>%
    select(pathway_short, NES, pval, padj, size) %>%
    mutate(
      NES = round(NES, 3),
      pval = signif(pval, 3),
      padj = signif(padj, 3)
    ) %>%
    knitr::kable(caption = "Top protein complexes by p-value") %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
}

# Bar plot of top complexes
n_show_complex <- min(25, nrow(gsea_complex))
p_complex_bar <- gsea_complex %>%
  head(n_show_complex) %>%
  mutate(pathway_short = str_trunc(pathway_short, 40),
         pathway_short = fct_reorder(pathway_short, NES)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pathway_short, y = NES, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Depleted in LOY" = "#2166AC",
                                "Enriched in LOY" = "#B2182B")) +
  labs(
    title = "GSEA: Protein Complexes (GO Cellular Component)",
    subtitle = "Ranked by CRISPR screen gene depletion",
    x = "Complex",
    y = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
    fill = "Direction"
  ) +
  theme_crispr() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

p_complex_bar

ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "module4_gsea_complexes_bar.pdf"), p_complex_bar,
       width = 10, height = 10)

write_csv(gsea_complex, file.path(results_dir, "module4_gsea_complexes.csv"))
```

## 4.5 SAGA Complex Analysis

The SAGA (Spt-Ada-Gcn5 Acetyltransferase) complex is a key chromatin-modifying complex involved in transcriptional regulation. Multiple SAGA subunits appear in our top hits.

```{r saga-analysis, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
# Define SAGA complex genes (from GO:CC SAGA_COMPLEX)
saga_genes <- c("ATXN7", "ATXN7L3", "ENY2", "KAT2A", "KAT2B", "PAAF1",
                "SF3B3", "SF3B5", "SGF29", "SUPT20H", "SUPT20HL1", "SUPT20HL2",
                "SUPT3H", "SUPT7L", "TADA1", "TADA2A", "TADA2B", "TADA3",
                "TAF10", "TAF12", "TAF5", "TAF5L", "TAF6", "TAF6L",
                "TAF9", "TRRAP", "USP22")

# Extract SAGA genes from screen results
saga_in_screen <- gene_summary %>%
  filter(id %in% saga_genes) %>%
  arrange(neg_fdr) %>%
  select(id, neg_fdr, neg_lfc, neg_goodsgrna, num)

cat("SAGA Complex Subunits in Screen:\n")
cat("  Total SAGA genes:", length(saga_genes), "\n")
cat("  Found in screen:", nrow(saga_in_screen), "\n")
cat("  Significant (FDR <", FDR_THRESHOLD, "):",
    sum(saga_in_screen$neg_fdr < FDR_THRESHOLD, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

# Display table
saga_in_screen %>%
  mutate(
    significant = ifelse(neg_fdr < FDR_THRESHOLD, "***", ""),
    neg_fdr = signif(neg_fdr, 3),
    neg_lfc = round(neg_lfc, 3)
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "SAGA complex subunits in CRISPR screen") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

# Visualize SAGA complex depletion
p_saga <- saga_in_screen %>%
  mutate(
    significant = neg_fdr < FDR_THRESHOLD,
    id = fct_reorder(id, neg_lfc)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = id, y = neg_lfc, fill = significant)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#8E44AD", "FALSE" = "grey70"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = paste0("FDR < ", FDR_THRESHOLD), "FALSE" = "NS")
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "SAGA Complex Subunit Depletion in LOY Cells",
    subtitle = paste0("Multiple subunits show significant depletion (FDR < ", FDR_THRESHOLD, ")"),
    x = "SAGA Subunit",
    y = "Log2 Fold Change (LOY vs CTRL)",
    fill = "Significance"
  ) +
  theme_crispr() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(p_saga)

ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "module4_saga_complex.pdf"), p_saga,
       width = 10, height = 6)

# Check GSEA result for SAGA complex specifically
saga_gsea <- gsea_complex %>%
  filter(grepl("SAGA", pathway, ignore.case = TRUE))

if(nrow(saga_gsea) > 0) {
  cat("\nGSEA Results for SAGA Complex:\n")
  saga_gsea %>%
    select(pathway, NES, pval, padj, size) %>%
    mutate(NES = round(NES, 3), pval = signif(pval, 3), padj = signif(padj, 3)) %>%
    print()

  # Plot enrichment curve for SAGA
  if("GOCC_SAGA_COMPLEX" %in% names(complex_pathways)) {
    p_saga_enrichment <- plotEnrichment(complex_pathways[["GOCC_SAGA_COMPLEX"]], gene_ranks) +
      labs(title = "GSEA Enrichment: SAGA Complex",
           subtitle = paste0("NES = ", round(saga_gsea$NES[1], 2),
                            " | padj = ", signif(saga_gsea$padj[1], 3))) +
      theme_crispr()
    print(p_saga_enrichment)

    ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "module4_saga_enrichment.pdf"), p_saga_enrichment,
           width = 8, height = 5)

cat("\n\nKey SAGA Complex Finding:\n")
cat("The SAGA complex shows strong enrichment for depleted genes in LOY cells.\n")
cat("This chromatin-modifying complex is essential for transcriptional regulation\n")
```

## 4.6 Enrichment Curves for Top Pathways

```{r enrichment-curves, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
# Function to plot enrichment curve
plot_enrichment <- function(pathway_name, pathways_list, ranks, title_prefix = "") {
  plotEnrichment(pathways_list[[pathway_name]], ranks) +
    labs(title = paste0(title_prefix, gsub("_", " ", pathway_name))) +
    theme_crispr()
}

# Top depleted pathways (negative NES)
top_depleted_pathways <- gsea_hallmark %>%
  filter(NES < 0) %>%
  arrange(pval) %>%
  head(4) %>%
  pull(pathway)

# Top enriched pathways (positive NES)
top_enriched_pathways <- gsea_hallmark %>%
  filter(NES > 0) %>%
  arrange(pval) %>%
  head(4) %>%
  pull(pathway)

cat("Plotting enrichment curves for top Hallmark pathways...\n\n")

# Plot top depleted
if (length(top_depleted_pathways) > 0) {
  cat("Top pathways with NEGATIVE NES (depleted in LOY screen):\n")
  for (pw in top_depleted_pathways) {
    cat(" -", pw, "\n")
    p <- plot_enrichment(pw, hallmark_pathways, gene_ranks, "")
    print(p)
  }
}

# Plot top enriched
if (length(top_enriched_pathways) > 0) {
  cat("\nTop pathways with POSITIVE NES (enriched in LOY screen):\n")
  for (pw in top_enriched_pathways) {
    cat(" -", pw, "\n")
    p <- plot_enrichment(pw, hallmark_pathways, gene_ranks, "")
    print(p)
  }
}
```

## 4.7 Leading Edge Analysis

```{r leading-edge}
# Extract leading edge genes from top pathways
extract_leading_edge <- function(gsea_result, pathways_list, top_n = 10) {
  gsea_result %>%
    arrange(pval) %>%
    head(top_n) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      leading_edge_genes = paste(leadingEdge, collapse = ", "),
      n_leading_edge = length(leadingEdge)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(pathway, NES, padj, n_leading_edge, leading_edge_genes)
}

# Leading edge for Hallmark
cat("Leading Edge Genes - Top Hallmark Pathways:\n\n")

leading_edge_hallmark <- extract_leading_edge(gsea_hallmark, hallmark_pathways, 10)

leading_edge_hallmark %>%
  mutate(
    pathway = gsub("HALLMARK_", "", pathway),
    NES = round(NES, 2),
    padj = signif(padj, 3)
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Leading edge genes for top Hallmark pathways") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

# Save leading edge data
write_csv(leading_edge_hallmark, file.path(results_dir, "module4_leading_edge_hallmark.csv"))

# Leading edge for KEGG
leading_edge_kegg <- extract_leading_edge(gsea_kegg, kegg_pathways, 10)
write_csv(leading_edge_kegg, file.path(results_dir, "module4_leading_edge_kegg.csv"))
```

## 4.9 Metascape Analysis

The depleted genes (neg|fdr < 0.25) and resistant/enriched genes (pos|fdr < 0.05) were submitted to [Metascape](https://metascape.org/) for independent pathway and network analysis. This section programmatically analyzes the Metascape CSV outputs for custom visualization and quantitative comparison.

**Key Findings**:
- Depleted genes: 20 enriched terms, #1 is **STAGA complex** (LogP = -16.3)
- Resistant genes: 62 enriched terms (3x more!) - different pathway profile

### 4.9.1 Load Metascape Data

```{r metascape-load-data}
# Define paths to Metascape results
metascape_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "metascape")

# Load enrichment results for both conditions
depleted_go <- read_csv(file.path(metascape_dir, "depleted/Enrichment_GO/_FINAL_GO.csv"),
                        show_col_types = FALSE)
resistant_go <- read_csv(file.path(metascape_dir, "resistant/Enrichment_GO/_FINAL_GO.csv"),
                         show_col_types = FALSE)

# Load MCODE protein clusters
mcode_depleted <- read_csv(file.path(metascape_dir, "depleted/Enrichment_PPI/MCODE.csv"),
                           show_col_types = FALSE)
mcode_resistant <- read_csv(file.path(metascape_dir, "resistant/Enrichment_PPI/MCODE.csv"),
                            show_col_types = FALSE)

# Load disease associations (DisGeNET)
disgenet_depleted <- tryCatch(
  read_csv(file.path(metascape_dir, "depleted/Enrichment_QC/GO_DisGeNET.csv"),
           show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

# Load TF targets
tf_targets <- tryCatch(
  read_csv(file.path(metascape_dir, "depleted/Enrichment_QC/GO_Transcription_Factor_Targets.csv"),
           show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

# Load gene evidence
evidence_depleted <- tryCatch(
  read_csv(file.path(metascape_dir, "depleted/Evidence/Evidence.csv"),
           show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) NULL
)
evidence_resistant <- tryCatch(
  read_csv(file.path(metascape_dir, "resistant/Evidence/Evidence.csv"),
           show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

cat("Metascape data loaded:\n")
cat("  Depleted GO terms:", nrow(depleted_go), "\n")
cat("  Resistant GO terms:", nrow(resistant_go), "\n")
cat("  MCODE clusters (depleted):", n_distinct(mcode_depleted$Cluster), "\n")
cat("  MCODE clusters (resistant):", n_distinct(mcode_resistant$Cluster), "\n")
```

### 4.9.6 Depleted vs Resistant Comparison

A key comparison: what pathways differ between genes essential in LOY cells (depleted) vs genes that provide growth advantage when lost (resistant/enriched)?

```{r metascape-comparison, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# Add condition labels
depleted_compare <- depleted_go %>%
  mutate(Condition = "Depleted (LOY essential)",
         neg_logp = -LogP) %>%
  select(Description, Category, neg_logp, Enrichment, `#GeneInGOAndHitList`, Condition)

resistant_compare <- resistant_go %>%
  mutate(Condition = "Resistant (LOY dispensable)",
         neg_logp = -LogP) %>%
  select(Description, Category, neg_logp, Enrichment, `#GeneInGOAndHitList`, Condition)

# Summary statistics
cat("=== Depleted vs Resistant Comparison ===\n\n")
cat("Depleted genes (essential in LOY):\n")
cat("  Total enriched terms:", nrow(depleted_go), "\n")
cat("  Categories:", paste(unique(depleted_go$Category), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

cat("Resistant genes (dispensable in LOY):\n")
cat("  Total enriched terms:", nrow(resistant_go), "\n")
cat("  Categories:", paste(unique(resistant_go$Category), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

cat("Key insight: Resistant has", round(nrow(resistant_go)/nrow(depleted_go), 1),
    "x more enriched terms than Depleted!\n")

# Category breakdown
cat("\nCategory breakdown:\n")
bind_rows(
  depleted_go %>% count(Category) %>% mutate(Condition = "Depleted"),
  resistant_go %>% count(Category) %>% mutate(Condition = "Resistant")
) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Condition, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  print()

# Side-by-side bar plot of top terms
top_depleted <- depleted_compare %>%
  arrange(desc(neg_logp)) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  mutate(neg_logp = -neg_logp)  # Make negative for left side

top_resistant <- resistant_compare %>%
  arrange(desc(neg_logp)) %>%
  head(10)

# Mirror bar plot
p_mirror <- bind_rows(
  top_depleted %>% mutate(Description = str_trunc(Description, 35)),
  top_resistant %>% mutate(Description = str_trunc(Description, 35))
) %>%
  mutate(
    Description = factor(Description),
    plot_value = ifelse(Condition == "Depleted (LOY essential)", -neg_logp, neg_logp)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = plot_value, y = reorder(Description, abs(plot_value)), fill = Condition)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", size = 0.5) +
```

### 4.9.7 Gene Evidence Summary

Metascape provides evidence scores for genes based on multiple data sources (hit list, GO, PPI).

```{r metascape-evidence, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
if (!is.null(evidence_depleted) && nrow(evidence_depleted) > 0) {

  # The Evidence file uses Entrez Gene IDs - we need to map to symbols
  # Create mapping from MCODE data which has both Gene (Entrez) and Symbol
  entrez_to_symbol <- mcode_depleted %>%
    select(Gene, Symbol) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(Gene = as.numeric(Gene))

  # Add symbols to evidence data
  evidence_with_symbols <- evidence_depleted %>%
    mutate(EntrezID = Gene) %>%
    left_join(entrez_to_symbol, by = "Gene") %>%
    mutate(Gene = ifelse(is.na(Symbol), as.character(EntrezID), Symbol))

  # Show genes with highest evidence counts
  evidence_summary <- evidence_with_symbols %>%
    arrange(desc(TotalEvidenceCounts)) %>%
    head(20)

  cat("=== Gene Evidence Summary (Depleted) ===\n")
  cat("Genes ranked by total evidence from multiple sources:\n\n")

  evidence_summary %>%
    select(Gene, TotalEvidenceCounts, everything(), -EntrezID, -Symbol) %>%
    knitr::kable(caption = "Top 20 Genes by Evidence Count")

  # Merge with CRISPR data for validation context (using gene symbols)
  evidence_with_crispr <- evidence_with_symbols %>%
    inner_join(gene_summary %>% select(id, neg_fdr, neg_lfc, neg_score),
               by = c("Gene" = "id")) %>%
    arrange(desc(TotalEvidenceCounts))

  cat("\nTop evidence genes with CRISPR statistics:\n")
  evidence_with_crispr %>%
    head(15) %>%
    select(Gene, TotalEvidenceCounts, neg_fdr, neg_lfc) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4))) %>%
    print()

  # Bar plot of evidence scores
  p_evidence <- evidence_summary %>%
    mutate(Gene = factor(Gene, levels = rev(Gene))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = TotalEvidenceCounts, y = Gene)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#E6AB02") +
    labs(
      title = "Gene Prioritization by Evidence Count",
      subtitle = "Genes with support from multiple data sources (hit list, GO, PPI)",
      x = "Total Evidence Count",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_crispr()

  print(p_evidence)

  ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "module4_metascape_evidence.pdf"), p_evidence,
         width = 12, height = 8)

} else {
  cat("Gene evidence data not available\n")
}
```

## 5.2 Top 50 Genes Heatmap

```{r top50-heatmap, fig.height=12, fig.width=10}
# Select top 50 genes by CRISPR significance (combining neg and pos)
top50_genes <- gene_summary %>%
  mutate(best_fdr = pmin(neg_fdr, pos_fdr, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(best_fdr) %>%
  head(50) %>%
  pull(id)

# Prepare data for heatmap
heatmap_data <- integrated_data %>%
  filter(id %in% top50_genes) %>%
  arrange(neg_fdr) %>%
  select(id, neg_lfc, rnaseq_logFC, chromosome, neg_fdr, concordance)

# Create matrix for heatmap
heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_data %>%
  select(id, neg_lfc, rnaseq_logFC) %>%
  column_to_rownames("id") %>%
  as.matrix()

colnames(heatmap_matrix) <- c("CRISPR LFC", "RNA-seq logFC")

# Create annotations
row_annotation <- heatmap_data %>%
  select(id, chromosome, concordance) %>%
  column_to_rownames("id")

# Define annotation colors
annotation_colors <- list(
  chromosome = c("X" = "#FF6600", "Autosome" = "grey70"),
  concordance = c(
    "Concordant (Depleted/Down)" = "#2166AC",
    "Concordant (Enriched/Up)" = "#B2182B",
    "Discordant (Depleted/Up)" = "#762A83",
    "Discordant (Enriched/Down)" = "#1B7837",
    "CRISPR only (Depleted)" = "#67A9CF",
    "CRISPR only (Enriched)" = "#EF8A62",
    "RNA-seq only" = "#F7F7F7",
    "Neither significant" = "grey80"
  )
)

# Create heatmap with pheatmap
p_heatmap <- pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,  # Keep FDR order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  scale = "none",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100),
  breaks = seq(-4, 4, length.out = 101),
  annotation_row = row_annotation,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  border_color = "grey80",
  cellwidth = 40,
  cellheight = 12,
  fontsize = 9,
  fontsize_row = 8,
  main = "Top 50 Genes: CRISPR Screen vs RNA-seq",
  silent = TRUE
)

# Display
print(p_heatmap)

# Save
pdf(file.path(results_dir, "module5_heatmap_top50.pdf"), width = 10, height = 14)
print(p_heatmap)
dev.off()

cat("Top 50 genes heatmap saved.\n")
```

## 5.3 X-Linked Gene Focus Figure

```{r x-linked-focus, fig.height=10, fig.width=12}
# Create comprehensive X-linked gene analysis figure

# Get all X-linked genes in the dataset
x_linked_full <- integrated_data %>%
  filter(is_x_linked) %>%
  arrange(neg_fdr)

if(nrow(x_linked_full) > 0) {

  # Panel A: Bar plot of CRISPR LFCs
  p_xlink_a <- x_linked_full %>%
    mutate(
      id = fct_reorder(id, neg_lfc),
      significant = neg_fdr < FDR_THRESHOLD
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = id, y = neg_lfc, fill = significant)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("TRUE" = "#FF6600", "FALSE" = "grey70"),
      labels = c("TRUE" = paste0("FDR < ", FDR_THRESHOLD), "FALSE" = "NS")
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "A. CRISPR Screen: X-Linked Gene Depletion",
      x = "Gene",
      y = "Log2 Fold Change (LOY vs CTRL)",
      fill = "Significance"
    ) +
    theme_crispr() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  # Panel B: RNA-seq comparison
  p_xlink_b <- x_linked_full %>%
    mutate(id = fct_reorder(id, neg_lfc)) %>%
    select(id, neg_lfc, rnaseq_logFC) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(neg_lfc, rnaseq_logFC),
                 names_to = "assay", values_to = "LFC") %>%
    mutate(assay = ifelse(assay == "neg_lfc", "CRISPR", "RNA-seq")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = id, y = LFC, fill = assay)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
             width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("CRISPR" = "#2166AC", "RNA-seq" = "#B2182B")) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "B. CRISPR vs RNA-seq Comparison",
      x = "Gene",
      y = "Log2 Fold Change",
      fill = "Assay"
    ) +
    theme_crispr() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  # Panel C: Scatter of X-linked genes
  p_xlink_c <- ggplot(x_linked_full, aes(x = neg_lfc, y = rnaseq_logFC)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(aes(size = -log10(neg_fdr)), color = "#FF6600", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = id), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "-log10(FDR)", range = c(2, 8)) +
    labs(
      title = "C. X-Linked Genes: CRISPR vs RNA-seq",
      x = "CRISPR Log2 Fold Change",
      y = "RNA-seq Log2 Fold Change"
    ) +
    theme_crispr() +
    theme(legend.position = "right") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-5, 2), ylim = c(-3, 3))

  # Panel D: Significance table
  x_linked_table <- x_linked_full %>%
    select(id, neg_fdr, neg_lfc, rnaseq_logFC, rnaseq_fdr, concordance) %>%
    mutate(
      neg_fdr = signif(neg_fdr, 3),
      neg_lfc = round(neg_lfc, 2),
      rnaseq_logFC = round(rnaseq_logFC, 2),
      rnaseq_fdr = signif(rnaseq_fdr, 3)
    )

  # Combine panels
  p_xlinked_combined <- (p_xlink_a | p_xlink_b) / p_xlink_c +
    plot_annotation(
      title = "X-Linked Gene Analysis: LOY Vulnerabilities",
      subtitle = "Genes on chromosome X may provide synthetic lethal targets in Y-loss cells",
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12)
      )
    )

  print(p_xlinked_combined)

  # Save
  ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "module5_x_linked_focus.pdf"),
         p_xlinked_combined, width = 12, height = 10)

  # Print table
  cat("\nX-Linked Gene Summary:\n\n")
  x_linked_table %>%
    knitr::kable(caption = "X-linked genes with CRISPR and RNA-seq data") %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
    print()

} else {
  cat("No X-linked genes found in integrated dataset.\n")
}
```

```{r key-findings}
# Screen summary

# Hit summary

cat("  Enriched genes (pos FDR <", FDR_THRESHOLD, "):", n_enriched, "\n\n")

# Top hits
cat("TOP 10 DEPLETED GENES (LOY vulnerabilities):\n")
gene_summary %>%
  filter(neg_significant) %>%
  arrange(neg_fdr) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    x_linked = ifelse(id %in% x_chromosome_genes, "*", ""),
    info = paste0(rank, ". ", id, x_linked, " (FDR=", signif(neg_fdr, 3),
                  ", LFC=", round(neg_lfc, 2), ")")
  ) %>%
  pull(info) %>%
  cat(sep = "\n")

cat("\n* = X-linked gene\n\n")

# X-linked genes
cat("X-LINKED GENES (Synthetic Lethality Candidates):\n")
if(exists("x_linked_full") && nrow(x_linked_full) > 0) {
  x_linked_full %>%
    filter(neg_fdr < FDR_THRESHOLD) %>%
    arrange(neg_fdr) %>%
    mutate(
      info = paste0("  ", id, ": FDR=", signif(neg_fdr, 3),
                    ", CRISPR LFC=", round(neg_lfc, 2),
                    ", RNA-seq logFC=", round(rnaseq_logFC, 2))
    ) %>%
    pull(info) %>%
    head(10) %>%
    cat(sep = "\n")
}

cat("\n\nPATHWAY ANALYSIS HIGHLIGHTS:\n")
cat("Top depleted pathways (essential in LOY):\n")
gsea_hallmark %>%
  filter(NES < 0) %>%
  head(5) %>%
  mutate(info = paste0("  - ", gsub("HALLMARK_", "", pathway),
                       " (NES=", round(NES, 2), ", padj=", signif(padj, 3), ")")) %>%
  pull(info) %>%
  cat(sep = "\n")

cat("\n\nINTEGRATION WITH RNA-seq:\n")
cat("  Genes with both CRISPR and RNA-seq data:", nrow(integrated_data), "\n")
cat("  Correlation (Pearson r):", round(cor_pearson, 3), "\n")
cat("  Concordant (CRISPR depleted + RNA down):",
    sum(integrated_data$concordance == "Concordant (Depleted/Down)"), "\n\n")

cat("=" %>% rep(60) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
cat("                    CONCLUSIONS\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(60) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n\n")

cat("1. DDX3X is the top synthetic lethal hit with LOY (FDR=0.0025)\n")
cat("   - X-linked DEAD-box RNA helicase\n")
cat("   - Known X-inactivation escapee\n")
cat("   - Strong CRISPR depletion (LFC=-3.32)\n\n")

cat("2. Multiple X-linked genes show LOY-specific dependencies\n")
cat("   - TIMM8A, BCORL1, USP9X among significant hits\n")
cat("   - Suggests dosage-sensitive vulnerabilities\n\n")

cat("3. Pathway analysis indicates altered essentiality of:\n")
cat("   - RNA processing/splicing pathways\n")
cat("   - Mitochondrial function (TIMM8A connection)\n")
cat("   - Chromatin regulation\n\n")

cat("4. CRISPR and RNA-seq show modest correlation (r=", round(cor_pearson, 2), ")\n", sep = "")
cat("   - Not all CRISPR hits are differentially expressed\n")
cat("   - Functional screen captures dependencies beyond expression\n\n")
```

# Module 6: D0 Outlier Filtering {.tabset}

This module filters outlier sgRNA guides from D0 samples using z-score threshold (±3 SD on log2 CPM).

## 6.1 Load and Prepare D0 Data

```{r d0-load-data}
# Extract D0 sample columns
d0_cols <- c("D0_CTRL", "D0_LOY")
post_cols <- c("POST_CTRL_REP1", "POST_CTRL_REP2", "POST_LOY_REP1", "POST_LOY_REP2")

# Create count matrix for D0 and POST
d0_counts <- counts %>% select(sgRNA, Gene, all_of(d0_cols))
post_counts <- counts %>% select(sgRNA, Gene, all_of(post_cols))

# Calculate library sizes
d0_lib_sizes <- colSums(d0_counts[, d0_cols])
post_lib_sizes <- colSums(post_counts[, post_cols])

cat("D0 Library Sizes:\n")
print(scales::comma(d0_lib_sizes))
cat("\nPOST Library Sizes:\n")
print(scales::comma(post_lib_sizes))

# Calculate CPM for D0 samples
d0_cpm <- d0_counts %>%
  mutate(
    D0_CTRL_CPM = D0_CTRL / d0_lib_sizes["D0_CTRL"] * 1e6,
    D0_LOY_CPM = D0_LOY / d0_lib_sizes["D0_LOY"] * 1e6
  )

# Calculate log2(CPM + 1) for D0 samples
d0_log2cpm <- d0_cpm %>%
  mutate(
    D0_CTRL_log2CPM = log2(D0_CTRL_CPM + 1),
    D0_LOY_log2CPM = log2(D0_LOY_CPM + 1)
  )

# Summary statistics
cat("\n===== D0 Log2(CPM+1) Summary =====\n")
cat("\nD0_CTRL:\n")
summary(d0_log2cpm$D0_CTRL_log2CPM) %>% print()
cat("\nD0_LOY:\n")
summary(d0_log2cpm$D0_LOY_log2CPM) %>% print()
```

```{r d0-distribution-plot, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
# Visualize D0 count distributions
p_d0_dist <- d0_log2cpm %>%
  select(sgRNA, D0_CTRL_log2CPM, D0_LOY_log2CPM) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(D0_CTRL_log2CPM, D0_LOY_log2CPM),
               names_to = "Sample", values_to = "log2CPM") %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_log2CPM", "", Sample)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2CPM, fill = Sample)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("D0_CTRL" = "#377EB8", "D0_LOY" = "#E41A1C")) +
  labs(
    title = "D0 Sample Count Distribution",
    subtitle = "Log2(CPM + 1) before outlier filtering",
    x = "Log2(CPM + 1)",
    y = "Number of sgRNAs"
  ) +
  theme_crispr() +
  facet_wrap(~Sample, ncol = 2)

print(p_d0_dist)
```

## 6.2 Identify Outliers (Z-score > 3)

```{r d0-identify-outliers}
# Calculate z-scores for each D0 sample
d0_zscore <- d0_log2cpm %>%
  mutate(
    D0_CTRL_zscore = (D0_CTRL_log2CPM - mean(D0_CTRL_log2CPM)) / sd(D0_CTRL_log2CPM),
    D0_LOY_zscore = (D0_LOY_log2CPM - mean(D0_LOY_log2CPM)) / sd(D0_LOY_log2CPM)
  )

# Define outlier threshold
ZSCORE_THRESHOLD <- 3

# Flag outliers (absolute z-score > 3 in EITHER sample)
d0_zscore <- d0_zscore %>%
  mutate(
    is_outlier_CTRL = abs(D0_CTRL_zscore) > ZSCORE_THRESHOLD,
    is_outlier_LOY = abs(D0_LOY_zscore) > ZSCORE_THRESHOLD,
    is_outlier_either = is_outlier_CTRL | is_outlier_LOY,
    is_outlier_both = is_outlier_CTRL & is_outlier_LOY,
    outlier_direction = case_when(
      D0_CTRL_zscore > ZSCORE_THRESHOLD | D0_LOY_zscore > ZSCORE_THRESHOLD ~ "High",
      D0_CTRL_zscore < -ZSCORE_THRESHOLD | D0_LOY_zscore < -ZSCORE_THRESHOLD ~ "Low",
      TRUE ~ "Normal"
    )
  )

# Summary statistics
n_outliers_ctrl <- sum(d0_zscore$is_outlier_CTRL)
n_outliers_loy <- sum(d0_zscore$is_outlier_LOY)
n_outliers_either <- sum(d0_zscore$is_outlier_either)
n_outliers_both <- sum(d0_zscore$is_outlier_both)
n_total <- nrow(d0_zscore)

cat("===== OUTLIER SUMMARY (|Z-score| > 3) =====\n\n")
cat(sprintf("D0_CTRL outliers: %d (%.2f%%)\n", n_outliers_ctrl, 100 * n_outliers_ctrl / n_total))
cat(sprintf("D0_LOY outliers: %d (%.2f%%)\n", n_outliers_loy, 100 * n_outliers_loy / n_total))
cat(sprintf("Outliers in EITHER sample: %d (%.2f%%)\n", n_outliers_either, 100 * n_outliers_either / n_total))
cat(sprintf("Outliers in BOTH samples: %d (%.2f%%)\n", n_outliers_both, 100 * n_outliers_both / n_total))

# Breakdown by direction
cat("\nOutlier direction breakdown:\n")
table(d0_zscore$outlier_direction) %>% print()
```

```{r d0-outlier-visualization, fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
# Calculate threshold values for visualization
ctrl_mean <- mean(d0_log2cpm$D0_CTRL_log2CPM)
ctrl_sd <- sd(d0_log2cpm$D0_CTRL_log2CPM)
loy_mean <- mean(d0_log2cpm$D0_LOY_log2CPM)
loy_sd <- sd(d0_log2cpm$D0_LOY_log2CPM)

# Histogram with outlier thresholds
p_outlier_hist <- d0_zscore %>%
  select(sgRNA, D0_CTRL_log2CPM, D0_LOY_log2CPM, is_outlier_either) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(D0_CTRL_log2CPM, D0_LOY_log2CPM),
               names_to = "Sample", values_to = "log2CPM") %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_log2CPM", "", Sample)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2CPM, fill = is_outlier_either)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(data = data.frame(Sample = c("D0_CTRL", "D0_CTRL", "D0_LOY", "D0_LOY"),
                                xint = c(ctrl_mean - 3*ctrl_sd, ctrl_mean + 3*ctrl_sd,
                                        loy_mean - 3*loy_sd, loy_mean + 3*loy_sd)),
             aes(xintercept = xint), linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey50", "TRUE" = "red"),
                    labels = c("Normal", "Outlier"),
                    name = "Status") +
  labs(
    title = "D0 Distribution with Outlier Thresholds",
    subtitle = "Red dashed lines = ±3 SD from mean",
    x = "Log2(CPM + 1)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_crispr() +
  facet_wrap(~Sample, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y")

# Scatter plot of D0_CTRL vs D0_LOY
p_scatter <- d0_zscore %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = D0_CTRL_log2CPM, y = D0_LOY_log2CPM, color = outlier_direction)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("High" = "red", "Low" = "blue", "Normal" = "grey70")) +
  labs(
    title = "D0_CTRL vs D0_LOY Correlation",
    subtitle = "Colored by outlier status",
    x = "D0_CTRL Log2(CPM + 1)",
    y = "D0_LOY Log2(CPM + 1)",
    color = "Outlier Type"
  ) +
  theme_crispr() +
  coord_fixed()

p_outlier_hist + p_scatter + plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1))
```

## 6.3 Characterize Outliers

```{r d0-characterize-outliers}
# Extract outlier guides
outlier_guides <- d0_zscore %>%
  filter(is_outlier_either) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(D0_CTRL_zscore) + abs(D0_LOY_zscore))) %>%
  select(sgRNA, Gene, D0_CTRL, D0_LOY, D0_CTRL_CPM, D0_LOY_CPM,
         D0_CTRL_zscore, D0_LOY_zscore, outlier_direction, is_outlier_both)

cat("===== TOP 30 OUTLIER GUIDES =====\n\n")
outlier_guides %>%
  head(30) %>%
  mutate(
    D0_CTRL_CPM = round(D0_CTRL_CPM, 1),
    D0_LOY_CPM = round(D0_LOY_CPM, 1),
    D0_CTRL_zscore = round(D0_CTRL_zscore, 2),
    D0_LOY_zscore = round(D0_LOY_zscore, 2)
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable() %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))

# Gene-level summary of outliers
outlier_gene_summary <- outlier_guides %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    n_outlier_guides = n(),
    mean_ctrl_cpm = mean(D0_CTRL_CPM),
    mean_loy_cpm = mean(D0_LOY_CPM),
    direction = first(outlier_direction),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_outlier_guides))

cat("\n===== GENES WITH MULTIPLE OUTLIER GUIDES =====\n\n")
outlier_gene_summary %>%
  filter(n_outlier_guides >= 2) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  knitr::kable() %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

# Check consistency between samples
cat("\n===== OUTLIER CONSISTENCY =====\n")
cat(sprintf("Outliers in both samples: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            n_outliers_both, n_outliers_either, 100 * n_outliers_both / n_outliers_either))
```

## 6.4 Create Filtered Count Matrix

```{r d0-create-filtered}
# Remove outlier guides from count matrix
counts_filtered <- counts %>%
  filter(!sgRNA %in% outlier_guides$sgRNA)

cat("===== FILTERING SUMMARY =====\n\n")
cat(sprintf("Original guides: %s\n", scales::comma(nrow(counts))))
cat(sprintf("Outlier guides removed: %s\n", scales::comma(nrow(outlier_guides))))
cat(sprintf("Remaining guides: %s\n", scales::comma(nrow(counts_filtered))))
cat(sprintf("Percentage retained: %.2f%%\n", 100 * nrow(counts_filtered) / nrow(counts)))

# Check genes affected
genes_before <- n_distinct(counts$Gene)
genes_after <- n_distinct(counts_filtered$Gene)
cat(sprintf("\nGenes before: %d\n", genes_before))
cat(sprintf("Genes after: %d\n", genes_after))
cat(sprintf("Genes lost: %d\n", genes_before - genes_after))

# Save filtered counts
write_csv(counts_filtered, file.path(results_dir, "module6_d0_filtered_counts.csv"))

# Save outlier guide list
outlier_export <- outlier_guides %>%
  select(sgRNA, Gene, D0_CTRL, D0_LOY, D0_CTRL_CPM, D0_LOY_CPM,
         D0_CTRL_zscore, D0_LOY_zscore, outlier_direction)
write_csv(outlier_export, file.path(results_dir, "module6_outlier_guides.csv"))

cat("\nFiles saved:\n")
cat("  - module6_d0_filtered_counts.csv\n")
cat("  - module6_outlier_guides.csv\n")
```

**Module 6 Complete.** Outlier guides have been identified and removed from D0 samples.
