# Module 7: Essential & Non-Essential Gene Reference Sets {.tabset}

This module loads Achilles/DepMap essential and non-essential gene sets for depletion analysis.

## 7.1 Load Achilles Core Essentials

```{r load-essentials}
# Load Achilles common essential genes
essential_file <- file.path(project_dir, "resources/AchillesCommonEssentialControls.csv")
essentials_raw <- read_csv(essential_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Parse gene symbols (format: "Gene (Entrez)")
essential_genes <- essentials_raw %>%
  mutate(Gene = str_extract(Gene, "^[^\\s(]+")) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()

cat("===== ACHILLES COMMON ESSENTIAL GENES =====\n\n")
cat(sprintf("Total essential genes loaded: %d\n", length(essential_genes)))
cat("\nFirst 20 essential genes:\n")
head(essential_genes, 20) %>% print()

# Check for ribosomal and proteasome genes
rpl_genes <- sum(grepl("^RPL", essential_genes))
rps_genes <- sum(grepl("^RPS", essential_genes))
psm_genes <- sum(grepl("^PSM", essential_genes))

cat(sprintf("\nRibosomal protein genes (RPL*): %d\n", rpl_genes))
cat(sprintf("Ribosomal protein genes (RPS*): %d\n", rps_genes))
cat(sprintf("Proteasome genes (PSM*): %d\n", psm_genes))
```

## 7.2 Load Achilles Non-Essentials

```{r load-nonessentials}
# Load Achilles non-essential genes
nonessential_file <- file.path(project_dir, "resources/AchillesNonessentialControls.csv")
nonessentials_raw <- read_csv(nonessential_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Parse gene symbols (format: "Gene (Entrez)")
nonessential_genes <- nonessentials_raw %>%
  mutate(Gene = str_extract(Gene, "^[^\\s(]+")) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()

cat("===== ACHILLES NON-ESSENTIAL GENES =====\n\n")
cat(sprintf("Total non-essential genes loaded: %d\n", length(nonessential_genes)))
cat("\nFirst 20 non-essential genes:\n")
head(nonessential_genes, 20) %>% print()

# Check for overlap (should be none)
overlap <- intersect(essential_genes, nonessential_genes)
if(length(overlap) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\nWARNING: %d genes appear in both lists!\n", length(overlap)))
} else {
  cat("\nNo overlap between essential and non-essential gene sets (as expected).\n")
}
```

## 7.3 Map to Brunello Library

```{r map-to-library}
# Get unique genes in the filtered count matrix
library_genes <- unique(counts_filtered$Gene)

# Map essential genes to library
essential_in_library <- intersect(essential_genes, library_genes)
essential_missing <- setdiff(essential_genes, library_genes)

# Map non-essential genes to library
nonessential_in_library <- intersect(nonessential_genes, library_genes)
nonessential_missing <- setdiff(nonessential_genes, library_genes)

cat("===== GENE SET MAPPING TO BRUNELLO LIBRARY =====\n\n")
cat("ESSENTIAL GENES:\n")
cat(sprintf("  In library: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            length(essential_in_library), length(essential_genes),
            100 * length(essential_in_library) / length(essential_genes)))
cat(sprintf("  Missing: %d\n", length(essential_missing)))

cat("\nNON-ESSENTIAL GENES:\n")
cat(sprintf("  In library: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            length(nonessential_in_library), length(nonessential_genes),
            100 * length(nonessential_in_library) / length(nonessential_genes)))
cat(sprintf("  Missing: %d\n", length(nonessential_missing)))

# Count sgRNAs per gene for essentials
essential_sgrna_counts <- counts_filtered %>%
  filter(Gene %in% essential_in_library) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(n_sgrnas = n(), .groups = "drop")

cat("\nsgRNAs per essential gene:\n")
table(essential_sgrna_counts$n_sgrnas) %>% print()

# Count sgRNAs per gene for non-essentials
nonessential_sgrna_counts <- counts_filtered %>%
  filter(Gene %in% nonessential_in_library) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(n_sgrnas = n(), .groups = "drop")

cat("\nsgRNAs per non-essential gene:\n")
table(nonessential_sgrna_counts$n_sgrnas) %>% print()
```

## 7.4 Non-Targeting Controls

```{r ntc-extraction}
# Extract non-targeting control guides
# NTC guides have Gene = "Non-Targeting-Control" and sgRNA like "Non-Targeting-Control_77433_SEQUENCE"
ntc_guides <- counts_filtered %>%
  filter(Gene == "Non-Targeting-Control")

cat("===== NON-TARGETING CONTROLS =====\n\n")
cat(sprintf("NTC guides in filtered library: %d\n", nrow(ntc_guides)))

# Debug: check unique gene names containing "control" or "target"
if(nrow(ntc_guides) == 0) {
  cat("\nDEBUG: No exact match found. Checking for similar gene names...\n")
  unique_genes <- unique(counts_filtered$Gene)
  potential_ntc <- unique_genes[grepl("control|target|ntc", unique_genes, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  cat("Genes containing 'control', 'target', or 'ntc':\n")
  print(potential_ntc)
}

if(nrow(ntc_guides) > 0) {
  # NTC count statistics
  cat("\nNTC count statistics (D0_CTRL):\n")
  summary(ntc_guides$D0_CTRL) %>% print()

  cat("\nNTC count statistics (D0_LOY):\n")
  summary(ntc_guides$D0_LOY) %>% print()

  # Show a few example NTC sgRNA names
  cat("\nExample NTC sgRNA names:\n")
  head(ntc_guides$sgRNA, 5) %>% print()
}

# Create gene category annotation
gene_categories <- counts_filtered %>%
  select(sgRNA, Gene) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      Gene %in% essential_in_library ~ "Essential",
      Gene %in% nonessential_in_library ~ "Non-Essential",
      Gene == "Non-Targeting-Control" ~ "NTC",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

cat("\n===== GENE CATEGORY SUMMARY =====\n")
gene_categories %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sgrnas = n(),
    n_genes = n_distinct(Gene),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable() %>%
  print()
```

# Module 8: Essential Gene Depletion Analysis {.tabset}

This module analyzes the dropout of essential genes from D0 to POST samples to validate screen quality.

## 8.1 Pooled Analysis (D0 vs POST)

```{r pooled-lfc-calculation}
# Calculate gene-level LFC using filtered counts
# Pooled analysis: average D0 vs average POST
# Filter: require minimum 50 reads in D0 (average)
# Aggregation: MEAN of sgRNAs for genes, individual for NTCs

MIN_D0_READS <- 50

# First, calculate sgRNA-level CPM and LFC
sgrna_lfc <- counts_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    # Average D0 raw counts for filtering
    D0_avg_raw = (D0_CTRL + D0_LOY) / 2,
    # Calculate CPM for each sample
    D0_CTRL_CPM = D0_CTRL / sum(D0_CTRL) * 1e6,
    D0_LOY_CPM = D0_LOY / sum(D0_LOY) * 1e6,
    POST_CTRL_REP1_CPM = POST_CTRL_REP1 / sum(POST_CTRL_REP1) * 1e6,
    POST_CTRL_REP2_CPM = POST_CTRL_REP2 / sum(POST_CTRL_REP2) * 1e6,
    POST_LOY_REP1_CPM = POST_LOY_REP1 / sum(POST_LOY_REP1) * 1e6,
    POST_LOY_REP2_CPM = POST_LOY_REP2 / sum(POST_LOY_REP2) * 1e6,
    # Average D0 and POST CPM
    D0_avg_CPM = (D0_CTRL_CPM + D0_LOY_CPM) / 2,
    POST_avg_CPM = (POST_CTRL_REP1_CPM + POST_CTRL_REP2_CPM + POST_LOY_REP1_CPM + POST_LOY_REP2_CPM) / 4,
    # Calculate LFC (POST vs D0)
    LFC_pooled = log2((POST_avg_CPM + 1) / (D0_avg_CPM + 1))
  )

# Add gene category
sgrna_lfc <- sgrna_lfc %>%
  left_join(gene_categories %>% select(sgRNA, category), by = "sgRNA")

# Report filtering
n_before_filter <- nrow(sgrna_lfc)
n_pass_filter <- sum(sgrna_lfc$D0_avg_raw >= MIN_D0_READS)
cat(sprintf("===== D0 READ COUNT FILTER (min %d reads) =====\n\n", MIN_D0_READS))
cat(sprintf("sgRNAs before filter: %d\n", n_before_filter))
cat(sprintf("sgRNAs passing filter: %d (%.1f%%)\n", n_pass_filter, 100 * n_pass_filter / n_before_filter))
cat(sprintf("sgRNAs removed: %d\n\n", n_before_filter - n_pass_filter))

# Apply filter
sgrna_lfc_filtered <- sgrna_lfc %>%
  filter(D0_avg_raw >= MIN_D0_READS)

# For NTCs: group into random sets of 3 to simulate "random genes"
# This better mimics gene-level analysis (3 sgRNAs per gene averaged)
set.seed(42)  # For reproducibility
ntc_sgrnas <- sgrna_lfc_filtered %>%
  filter(category == "NTC") %>%
  select(sgRNA, LFC_pooled)

# Shuffle and assign to groups of 3
n_ntc <- nrow(ntc_sgrnas)
n_groups <- floor(n_ntc / 3)
ntc_sgrnas <- ntc_sgrnas %>%
  slice_sample(n = n_ntc) %>%  # Shuffle
  mutate(group_id = rep(1:n_groups, each = 3, length.out = n()))

# Average LFC within each group to create "random genes"
ntc_lfc_pooled <- ntc_sgrnas %>%
  filter(group_id <= n_groups) %>%  # Exclude remainder guides (if n_ntc not divisible by 3)
  group_by(group_id) %>%
  summarise(
    Gene = paste0("RandomGene_", first(group_id)),
    category = "Random",
    n_sgrnas = 3,
    LFC = mean(LFC_pooled),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(Gene, category, n_sgrnas, LFC)

cat(sprintf("NTC guides: %d total, grouped into %d 'random genes' of 3 guides each\n", n_ntc, n_groups))

# Gene-level LFC for targeting genes (MEAN of sgRNAs)
gene_lfc_pooled <- sgrna_lfc_filtered %>%
  filter(category != "NTC") %>%
  group_by(Gene, category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sgrnas = n(),
    LFC = mean(LFC_pooled),  # MEAN, not median
    LFC_sd = sd(LFC_pooled),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Combine NTCs and genes
all_lfc_pooled <- bind_rows(
  gene_lfc_pooled %>% select(Gene, category, n_sgrnas, LFC),
  ntc_lfc_pooled
)

cat("===== POOLED LFC ANALYSIS (POST vs D0) =====\n\n")
cat("LFC summary by category:\n\n")

all_lfc_pooled %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_entries = n(),
    median_LFC = median(LFC),
    mean_LFC = mean(LFC),
    sd_LFC = sd(LFC),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3) %>%
  print()

cat("\nNote: Essential/Non-Essential/Other = gene-level (mean of sgRNAs)\n")
cat("      Random = NTC guides grouped into sets of 3 (mean LFC)\n")
```

## 8.2 Per-Condition Analysis

```{r per-condition-lfc}
# Calculate condition-specific LFC with same filters as pooled
# Filter: min 50 reads in D0 for each condition separately

sgrna_lfc_condition <- counts_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    # CPM normalization
    D0_CTRL_CPM = D0_CTRL / sum(D0_CTRL) * 1e6,
    D0_LOY_CPM = D0_LOY / sum(D0_LOY) * 1e6,
    POST_CTRL_REP1_CPM = POST_CTRL_REP1 / sum(POST_CTRL_REP1) * 1e6,
    POST_CTRL_REP2_CPM = POST_CTRL_REP2 / sum(POST_CTRL_REP2) * 1e6,
    POST_LOY_REP1_CPM = POST_LOY_REP1 / sum(POST_LOY_REP1) * 1e6,
    POST_LOY_REP2_CPM = POST_LOY_REP2 / sum(POST_LOY_REP2) * 1e6,
    # CTRL arm: D0_CTRL vs POST_CTRL average
    POST_CTRL_avg_CPM = (POST_CTRL_REP1_CPM + POST_CTRL_REP2_CPM) / 2,
    LFC_CTRL = log2((POST_CTRL_avg_CPM + 1) / (D0_CTRL_CPM + 1)),
    # LOY arm: D0_LOY vs POST_LOY average
    POST_LOY_avg_CPM = (POST_LOY_REP1_CPM + POST_LOY_REP2_CPM) / 2,
    LFC_LOY = log2((POST_LOY_avg_CPM + 1) / (D0_LOY_CPM + 1)),
    # Filter flags
    pass_CTRL = D0_CTRL >= MIN_D0_READS,
    pass_LOY = D0_LOY >= MIN_D0_READS
  ) %>%
  left_join(gene_categories %>% select(sgRNA, category), by = "sgRNA")

# NTCs: group into random sets of 3 (same as pooled analysis)
set.seed(42)  # Same seed for reproducibility
ntc_sgrnas_condition <- sgrna_lfc_condition %>%
  filter(category == "NTC") %>%
  select(sgRNA, LFC_CTRL, LFC_LOY, pass_CTRL, pass_LOY)

n_ntc_cond <- nrow(ntc_sgrnas_condition)
n_groups_cond <- floor(n_ntc_cond / 3)
ntc_sgrnas_condition <- ntc_sgrnas_condition %>%
  slice_sample(n = n_ntc_cond) %>%
  mutate(group_id = rep(1:n_groups_cond, each = 3, length.out = n()))

ntc_lfc_condition <- ntc_sgrnas_condition %>%
  filter(group_id <= n_groups_cond) %>%
  group_by(group_id) %>%
  summarise(
    Gene = paste0("RandomGene_", first(group_id)),
    category = "Random",
    n_sgrnas = 3,
    LFC_CTRL = ifelse(sum(pass_CTRL) > 0, mean(LFC_CTRL[pass_CTRL], na.rm = TRUE), NA),
    LFC_LOY = ifelse(sum(pass_LOY) > 0, mean(LFC_LOY[pass_LOY], na.rm = TRUE), NA),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(Gene, category, n_sgrnas, LFC_CTRL, LFC_LOY)

# Gene-level LFC per condition (MEAN of sgRNAs)
gene_lfc_condition <- sgrna_lfc_condition %>%
  filter(category != "NTC") %>%
  group_by(Gene, category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sgrnas = n(),
    n_pass_CTRL = sum(pass_CTRL),
    n_pass_LOY = sum(pass_LOY),
    LFC_CTRL = ifelse(n_pass_CTRL > 0, mean(LFC_CTRL[pass_CTRL]), NA),
    LFC_LOY = ifelse(n_pass_LOY > 0, mean(LFC_LOY[pass_LOY]), NA),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Combine
all_lfc_condition <- bind_rows(
  gene_lfc_condition %>% select(Gene, category, n_sgrnas, LFC_CTRL, LFC_LOY),
  ntc_lfc_condition
)

cat("===== PER-CONDITION LFC ANALYSIS =====\n\n")
cat("CTRL arm (D0_CTRL vs POST_CTRL):\n")
all_lfc_condition %>%
  filter(!is.na(LFC_CTRL)) %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_entries = n(),
    median_LFC = median(LFC_CTRL),
    mean_LFC = mean(LFC_CTRL),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3) %>%
  print()

cat("\nLOY arm (D0_LOY vs POST_LOY):\n")
all_lfc_condition %>%
  filter(!is.na(LFC_LOY)) %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_entries = n(),
    median_LFC = median(LFC_LOY),
    mean_LFC = mean(LFC_LOY),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3) %>%
  print()
```

## 8.3 Statistical Testing

```{r statistical-tests}
# Statistical comparison of essential vs non-essential LFC distributions
cat("===== STATISTICAL TESTS =====\n\n")

# Pooled analysis - use all_lfc_pooled
essential_lfc <- all_lfc_pooled %>% filter(category == "Essential") %>% pull(LFC)
nonessential_lfc <- all_lfc_pooled %>% filter(category == "Non-Essential") %>% pull(LFC)
random_lfc <- all_lfc_pooled %>% filter(category == "Random") %>% pull(LFC)

# Wilcoxon test: Essential vs Non-Essential
wilcox_ess_noness <- wilcox.test(essential_lfc, nonessential_lfc)
cat("1. POOLED ANALYSIS:\n")
cat(sprintf("   Essential vs Non-Essential (Wilcoxon): p = %.2e\n", wilcox_ess_noness$p.value))

# Wilcoxon test: Essential vs Random (grouped NTCs)
if(length(random_lfc) > 0) {
  wilcox_ess_random <- wilcox.test(essential_lfc, random_lfc)
  cat(sprintf("   Essential vs Random (Wilcoxon): p = %.2e\n", wilcox_ess_random$p.value))
}

# Cohen's d effect size
cohens_d <- function(x, y) {
  nx <- length(x)
  ny <- length(y)
  pooled_sd <- sqrt(((nx-1)*sd(x)^2 + (ny-1)*sd(y)^2) / (nx + ny - 2))
  d <- (mean(x) - mean(y)) / pooled_sd
  return(d)
}

d_ess_noness <- cohens_d(essential_lfc, nonessential_lfc)
cat(sprintf("   Cohen's d (Essential vs Non-Essential): %.3f\n", d_ess_noness))

# Per-condition tests
cat("\n2. PER-CONDITION ANALYSIS:\n")

# CTRL arm
essential_ctrl <- all_lfc_condition %>% filter(category == "Essential", !is.na(LFC_CTRL)) %>% pull(LFC_CTRL)
nonessential_ctrl <- all_lfc_condition %>% filter(category == "Non-Essential", !is.na(LFC_CTRL)) %>% pull(LFC_CTRL)
wilcox_ctrl <- wilcox.test(essential_ctrl, nonessential_ctrl)
d_ctrl <- cohens_d(essential_ctrl, nonessential_ctrl)
cat(sprintf("   CTRL arm - Essential vs Non-Essential: p = %.2e, Cohen's d = %.3f\n",
            wilcox_ctrl$p.value, d_ctrl))

# LOY arm
essential_loy <- all_lfc_condition %>% filter(category == "Essential", !is.na(LFC_LOY)) %>% pull(LFC_LOY)
nonessential_loy <- all_lfc_condition %>% filter(category == "Non-Essential", !is.na(LFC_LOY)) %>% pull(LFC_LOY)
wilcox_loy <- wilcox.test(essential_loy, nonessential_loy)
d_loy <- cohens_d(essential_loy, nonessential_loy)
cat(sprintf("   LOY arm - Essential vs Non-Essential: p = %.2e, Cohen's d = %.3f\n",
            wilcox_loy$p.value, d_loy))

# Compare depletion magnitude between conditions
cat("\n3. CONDITION COMPARISON:\n")

# For paired test, need genes with valid LFC in BOTH conditions
paired_data <- all_lfc_condition %>%
  filter(category == "Essential", !is.na(LFC_CTRL), !is.na(LFC_LOY))

if(nrow(paired_data) > 10) {
  paired_test <- wilcox.test(paired_data$LFC_CTRL, paired_data$LFC_LOY, paired = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("   Essential gene depletion CTRL vs LOY (paired Wilcoxon): p = %.2e\n",
              paired_test$p.value))
  cat(sprintf("   Genes with both conditions: %d\n", nrow(paired_data)))
} else {
  cat("   Insufficient paired data for comparison\n")
}
cat(sprintf("   Mean LFC essentials - CTRL: %.3f, LOY: %.3f\n",
            mean(essential_ctrl), mean(essential_loy)))
```

```{r roc-analysis, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
# ROC analysis for essential gene classification
library(pROC)

# Prepare data for ROC (binary: Essential vs Non-Essential)
roc_data <- all_lfc_pooled %>%
  filter(category %in% c("Essential", "Non-Essential")) %>%
  mutate(is_essential = ifelse(category == "Essential", 1, 0))

# ROC curve using negative LFC (more negative = more likely essential)
roc_obj <- roc(roc_data$is_essential, -roc_data$LFC, quiet = TRUE)
auc_value <- auc(roc_obj)

cat("\n4. ROC ANALYSIS:\n")
cat(sprintf("   AUC for essential gene classification: %.3f\n", auc_value))

# Plot ROC curve
p_roc <- ggroc(roc_obj, legacy.axes = TRUE) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(
    title = "ROC: Essential Gene Classification",
    subtitle = sprintf("AUC = %.3f (using negative LFC as predictor)", auc_value),
    x = "False Positive Rate (1 - Specificity)",
    y = "True Positive Rate (Sensitivity)"
  ) +
  theme_crispr() +
  coord_fixed()

print(p_roc)
```

## 8.5 Quality Assessment

```{r quality-metrics}
cat("===== D0 DATA QUALITY ASSESSMENT =====\n\n")

# Key metrics for screen quality
cat("1. ESSENTIAL GENE SEPARATION:\n")
cat(sprintf("   Median LFC (Essential): %.3f\n", median(essential_lfc)))
cat(sprintf("   Median LFC (Non-Essential): %.3f\n", median(nonessential_lfc)))
cat(sprintf("   Separation (delta): %.3f\n", median(nonessential_lfc) - median(essential_lfc)))
cat(sprintf("   Cohen's d effect size: %.3f\n", d_ess_noness))

# Interpretation guidelines
cat("\n2. QUALITY INTERPRETATION:\n")
if(auc_value >= 0.9) {
  cat("   AUC >= 0.9: EXCELLENT screen quality\n")
} else if(auc_value >= 0.8) {
  cat("   AUC >= 0.8: GOOD screen quality\n")
} else if(auc_value >= 0.7) {
  cat("   AUC >= 0.7: ACCEPTABLE screen quality\n")
} else {
  cat("   AUC < 0.7: POOR screen quality - interpret with caution\n")
}

if(abs(d_ess_noness) >= 1.0) {
  cat("   |Cohen's d| >= 1.0: LARGE effect size\n")
} else if(abs(d_ess_noness) >= 0.5) {
  cat("   |Cohen's d| >= 0.5: MEDIUM effect size\n")
} else {
  cat("   |Cohen's d| < 0.5: SMALL effect size\n")
}

# Percentage of essentials with negative LFC
pct_ess_depleted <- 100 * sum(essential_lfc < 0) / length(essential_lfc)
pct_noness_depleted <- 100 * sum(nonessential_lfc < 0) / length(nonessential_lfc)

cat("\n3. DEPLETION RATES:\n")
cat(sprintf("   Essential genes with LFC < 0: %.1f%%\n", pct_ess_depleted))
cat(sprintf("   Non-Essential genes with LFC < 0: %.1f%%\n", pct_noness_depleted))

cat("\n4. CONCLUSION:\n")
if(auc_value >= 0.8 && abs(d_ess_noness) >= 0.5 && pct_ess_depleted > 70) {
  cat("   D0 data IS USABLE after outlier filtering.\n")
  cat("   Essential genes show expected depletion pattern.\n")
} else {
  cat("   D0 data quality is MARGINAL - interpret results with caution.\n")
}
```

```{r module9-summary-table}
    sprintf("%.3f", median(essential_lfc)),
    sprintf("%.3f", median(nonessential_lfc)),
    sprintf("%.3f", median(nonessential_lfc) - median(essential_lfc)),
    sprintf("%.3f", d_ess_noness),
    sprintf("%.2e", wilcox_ess_noness$p.value),
    sprintf("%.3f", auc_value),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_ess_depleted),
    # Quality metrics - CTRL arm
    sprintf("%.3f", median(essential_ctrl)),
    sprintf("%.3f", median(nonessential_ctrl)),
    sprintf("%.3f", d_ctrl),
    # Quality metrics - LOY arm
    sprintf("%.3f", median(essential_loy)),
    sprintf("%.3f", median(nonessential_loy)),
    sprintf("%.3f", d_loy)
  )
)

cat("===== D0 ANALYSIS SUMMARY =====\n\n")
d0_analysis_summary %>%
  knitr::kable() %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

## 9.2 Export Results

```{r module9-export}
# 1. Export pooled LFC (genes + NTCs)
pooled_export <- all_lfc_pooled %>%
  select(Gene, category, n_sgrnas, LFC) %>%
  arrange(LFC)

write_csv(pooled_export,
          file.path(results_dir, "module8_essential_depletion_pooled.csv"))

# 2. Export per-condition LFC (genes + NTCs)
condition_export <- all_lfc_condition %>%
  select(Gene, category, n_sgrnas, LFC_CTRL, LFC_LOY) %>%
  arrange(LFC_CTRL)

write_csv(condition_export,
          file.path(results_dir, "module8_essential_depletion_per_condition.csv"))

# 3. Export essential gene LFC specifically
essential_gene_export <- all_lfc_condition %>%
  filter(category == "Essential") %>%
  select(Gene, n_sgrnas, LFC_CTRL, LFC_LOY) %>%
  mutate(
    LFC_diff = LFC_LOY - LFC_CTRL,
    more_depleted_in = ifelse(LFC_LOY < LFC_CTRL, "LOY", "CTRL")
  ) %>%
  arrange(LFC_CTRL)

write_csv(essential_gene_export,
          file.path(results_dir, "module8_essential_gene_lfc.csv"))

# 4. Export summary statistics
write_csv(d0_analysis_summary,
          file.path(results_dir, "module9_d0_analysis_summary.csv"))

cat("===== EXPORTED FILES =====\n\n")
cat("1. module6_d0_filtered_counts.csv - Filtered count matrix (outliers removed)\n")
cat("2. module6_outlier_guides.csv - List of outlier guides\n")
cat("3. module8_essential_depletion_pooled.csv - Pooled LFC by gene\n")
cat("4. module8_essential_depletion_per_condition.csv - Per-condition LFC\n")
cat("5. module8_essential_gene_lfc.csv - Essential genes with condition comparison\n")
cat("6. module9_d0_analysis_summary.csv - Summary statistics\n")
```

## 9.3 Key Findings

```{r module9-findings}
cat("=" %>% rep(60) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
cat("       D0 ESSENTIAL GENE ANALYSIS - KEY FINDINGS\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(60) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n\n")

cat("1. OUTLIER FILTERING:\n")
cat(sprintf("   - Removed %d outlier guides (%.2f%% of library)\n",
            nrow(outlier_guides), 100 * nrow(outlier_guides) / nrow(counts)))
cat(sprintf("   - %d genes retained for analysis\n", genes_after))

cat("\n2. ESSENTIAL GENE DEPLETION (Pooled):\n")
cat(sprintf("   - Essential genes: median LFC = %.2f\n", median(essential_lfc)))
cat(sprintf("   - Non-essential genes: median LFC = %.2f\n", median(nonessential_lfc)))
cat(sprintf("   - Separation: %.2f log2 fold change\n",
            median(nonessential_lfc) - median(essential_lfc)))

cat("\n3. SCREEN QUALITY METRICS:\n")
cat(sprintf("   - AUC = %.3f", auc_value))
if(auc_value >= 0.8) cat(" (GOOD)\n") else if(auc_value >= 0.7) cat(" (ACCEPTABLE)\n") else cat(" (POOR)\n")
cat(sprintf("   - Cohen's d = %.2f", d_ess_noness))
if(abs(d_ess_noness) >= 1.0) cat(" (LARGE)\n") else if(abs(d_ess_noness) >= 0.5) cat(" (MEDIUM)\n") else cat(" (SMALL)\n")
cat(sprintf("   - %.1f%% of essential genes depleted (LFC < 0)\n", pct_ess_depleted))

cat("\n4. CONDITION COMPARISON:\n")
cat(sprintf("   - CTRL arm: Essential median LFC = %.2f\n", median(essential_ctrl)))
cat(sprintf("   - LOY arm: Essential median LFC = %.2f\n", median(essential_loy)))
if(median(essential_loy) < median(essential_ctrl)) {
  cat("   - Essential genes more depleted in LOY arm\n")
} else {
  cat("   - Essential genes more depleted in CTRL arm\n")
}

cat("\n5. INTERPRETATION:\n")
if(auc_value >= 0.8 && abs(d_ess_noness) >= 0.5) {
  cat("   The D0 samples show good separation between essential and\n")
  cat("   non-essential genes after outlier removal. The data appears\n")
  cat("   USABLE for downstream analysis comparing D0 vs POST timepoints.\n")
} else if(auc_value >= 0.7) {
  cat("   The D0 samples show acceptable but not ideal separation.\n")
  cat("   Results should be interpreted with some caution.\n")
} else {
  cat("   The D0 samples show poor essential gene separation.\n")
  cat("   Consider excluding D0 from differential analyses.\n")
}

cat("\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(60) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
```

**Module 9 Complete.** D0 analysis summary and results have been exported.

# Module 10: Summary Excel Export {.tabset}

This module creates a comprehensive Excel workbook for collaborators with all screen results, expression data, and annotations.

## 10.1 Load Data Sources

```{r module10-setup}
library(openxlsx)

cat("===== LOADING DATA FOR EXCEL SUMMARY =====\n\n")

# Define paths (using project_dir from setup chunk)
mageck_gene_file <- file.path(project_dir, "test/POST_LOY_vs_CTRL.gene_summary.txt")
mageck_sgrna_file <- file.path(project_dir, "test/POST_LOY_vs_CTRL.sgrna_summary.txt")
count_file_m10 <- file.path(project_dir, "count/ht1080_screen2_R1.count.txt")
lcpm_file <- "A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/data/RNAseq/AUG_13_2025_LOY_A549_HT1080/DE/lcpm_matrix.csv"
de_file <- "A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/data/RNAseq/AUG_13_2025_LOY_A549_HT1080/DE/ht1080_LOY_v_WT_DE_noY.csv"
integrated_file <- file.path(results_dir, "module3_integrated_data.csv")

# Load MAGeCK gene summary
mageck_gene <- read.delim(mageck_gene_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("MAGeCK gene summary: %d genes\n", nrow(mageck_gene)))

# Load MAGeCK sgRNA summary
mageck_sgrna <- read.delim(mageck_sgrna_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("MAGeCK sgRNA summary: %d sgRNAs\n", nrow(mageck_sgrna)))

# Load count matrix
count_matrix <- read.delim(count_file_m10, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Count matrix: %d sgRNAs\n", nrow(count_matrix)))

# Load expression matrix (logCPM values)
lcpm_matrix <- read.csv(lcpm_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Expression matrix: %d genes\n", nrow(lcpm_matrix)))

# Load RNA-seq DE results
de_results <- read.csv(de_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("RNA-seq DE results: %d genes\n", nrow(de_results)))

# Load integrated data (has chromosome info)
integrated_data <- read.csv(integrated_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Integrated data: %d genes\n", nrow(integrated_data)))

# Load essential/non-essential gene lists (already loaded in Module 7, but reload for clarity)
essential_raw <- read.csv(file.path(project_dir, "resources/AchillesCommonEssentialControls.csv"),
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
nonessential_raw <- read.csv(file.path(project_dir, "resources/AchillesNonessentialControls.csv"),
                             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Parse gene symbols
essential_genes <- str_extract(essential_raw$Gene, "^[^\\s(]+")
nonessential_genes <- str_extract(nonessential_raw$Gene, "^[^\\s(]+")
cat(sprintf("Essential genes: %d\n", length(essential_genes)))
cat(sprintf("Non-essential genes: %d\n", length(nonessential_genes)))
```

## 10.2 Build Gene Summary Table

```{r module10-gene-summary}
cat("===== BUILDING GENE SUMMARY TABLE =====\n\n")

# Start with MAGeCK gene summary
gene_summary <- mageck_gene %>%
  rename(
    Gene = id,
    n_sgRNAs = num,
    CRISPR_neg_score = `neg.score`,
    CRISPR_neg_pvalue = `neg.p.value`,
    CRISPR_neg_FDR = `neg.fdr`,
    CRISPR_neg_rank = `neg.rank`,
    CRISPR_neg_goodsgrna = `neg.goodsgrna`,
    CRISPR_neg_LFC = `neg.lfc`,
    CRISPR_pos_score = `pos.score`,
    CRISPR_pos_pvalue = `pos.p.value`,
    CRISPR_pos_FDR = `pos.fdr`,
    CRISPR_pos_rank = `pos.rank`,
    CRISPR_pos_goodsgrna = `pos.goodsgrna`,
    CRISPR_pos_LFC = `pos.lfc`
  )

# Add chromosome info from integrated data
chrom_info <- integrated_data %>%
  select(gene, chromosome, is_x_linked) %>%
  rename(Gene = gene)

gene_summary <- gene_summary %>%
  left_join(chrom_info, by = "Gene")

# Determine CRISPR direction
gene_summary <- gene_summary %>%
  mutate(
    CRISPR_direction = case_when(
      CRISPR_neg_FDR < 0.1 & CRISPR_neg_LFC < 0 ~ "Depleted",
      CRISPR_pos_FDR < 0.1 & CRISPR_pos_LFC > 0 ~ "Enriched",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    )
  )

# Extract HT1080 expression data from lcpm matrix
ht1080_expr <- lcpm_matrix %>%
  select(gene_name,
         ht1080_ctrl_1, ht1080_ctrl_2, ht1080_ctrl_3,
         ht1080_loy_1, ht1080_loy_2, ht1080_loy_3) %>%
  rename(
    Gene = gene_name,
    expr_CTRL_rep1 = ht1080_ctrl_1,
    expr_CTRL_rep2 = ht1080_ctrl_2,
    expr_CTRL_rep3 = ht1080_ctrl_3,
    expr_LOY_rep1 = ht1080_loy_1,
    expr_LOY_rep2 = ht1080_loy_2,
    expr_LOY_rep3 = ht1080_loy_3
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    expr_CTRL_mean = (expr_CTRL_rep1 + expr_CTRL_rep2 + expr_CTRL_rep3) / 3,
    expr_LOY_mean = (expr_LOY_rep1 + expr_LOY_rep2 + expr_LOY_rep3) / 3
  )

gene_summary <- gene_summary %>%
  left_join(ht1080_expr, by = "Gene")

# Add RNA-seq DE results
rnaseq_de <- de_results %>%
  select(gene_name, logFC, logCPM, FDR) %>%
  rename(
    Gene = gene_name,
    RNAseq_logFC = logFC,
    RNAseq_logCPM = logCPM,
    RNAseq_FDR = FDR
  )

gene_summary <- gene_summary %>%
  left_join(rnaseq_de, by = "Gene")

# Add essential/non-essential classification
gene_summary <- gene_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Essential = case_when(
      Gene %in% essential_genes ~ "Essential",
      Gene %in% nonessential_genes ~ "Non-Essential",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# Reorder columns for clarity
gene_summary <- gene_summary %>%
  select(
    Gene, chromosome, is_x_linked,
    n_sgRNAs, CRISPR_neg_goodsgrna, CRISPR_pos_goodsgrna,
    CRISPR_neg_LFC, CRISPR_neg_FDR, CRISPR_neg_pvalue, CRISPR_neg_rank,
    CRISPR_pos_LFC, CRISPR_pos_FDR, CRISPR_pos_pvalue, CRISPR_pos_rank,
    CRISPR_direction,
    expr_CTRL_rep1, expr_CTRL_rep2, expr_CTRL_rep3,
    expr_LOY_rep1, expr_LOY_rep2, expr_LOY_rep3,
    expr_CTRL_mean, expr_LOY_mean,
    RNAseq_logFC, RNAseq_logCPM, RNAseq_FDR,
    Essential
  ) %>%
  arrange(CRISPR_neg_FDR)

cat(sprintf("Gene summary table: %d genes x %d columns\n", nrow(gene_summary), ncol(gene_summary)))
cat("\nColumn names:\n")
cat(paste(names(gene_summary), collapse = "\n"))

# Show summary statistics
cat("\n\n===== SUMMARY STATISTICS =====\n")
cat(sprintf("Genes with expression data: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(!is.na(gene_summary$expr_CTRL_mean)),
            100 * sum(!is.na(gene_summary$expr_CTRL_mean)) / nrow(gene_summary)))
cat(sprintf("Genes with RNA-seq DE data: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(!is.na(gene_summary$RNAseq_FDR)),
            100 * sum(!is.na(gene_summary$RNAseq_FDR)) / nrow(gene_summary)))
cat(sprintf("Essential genes: %d\n", sum(gene_summary$Essential == "Essential")))
cat(sprintf("Non-essential genes: %d\n", sum(gene_summary$Essential == "Non-Essential")))
```

## 10.3 Build sgRNA Summary Table

```{r module10-sgrna-summary}
cat("===== BUILDING sgRNA SUMMARY TABLE =====\n\n")

# Start with count matrix
sgrna_summary <- count_matrix %>%
  select(sgRNA, Gene, D0_CTRL, D0_LOY,
         POST_CTRL_REP1, POST_CTRL_REP2, POST_LOY_REP1, POST_LOY_REP2)

# Add LFC and FDR from MAGeCK sgRNA summary
mageck_sgrna_slim <- mageck_sgrna %>%
  select(sgrna, Gene, LFC, FDR) %>%
  rename(sgRNA = sgrna, sgrna_LFC = LFC, sgrna_FDR = FDR)

sgrna_summary <- sgrna_summary %>%
  left_join(mageck_sgrna_slim %>% select(sgRNA, sgrna_LFC, sgrna_FDR), by = "sgRNA")

# Add chromosome info (from gene level)
gene_chrom <- gene_summary %>%
  select(Gene, chromosome) %>%
  distinct()

sgrna_summary <- sgrna_summary %>%
  left_join(gene_chrom, by = "Gene")

# Add essential classification
sgrna_summary <- sgrna_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Essential = case_when(
      Gene == "Non-Targeting-Control" ~ "NTC",
      Gene %in% essential_genes ~ "Essential",
      Gene %in% nonessential_genes ~ "Non-Essential",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# Reorder columns
sgrna_summary <- sgrna_summary %>%
  select(
    sgRNA, Gene, chromosome,
    D0_CTRL, D0_LOY, POST_CTRL_REP1, POST_CTRL_REP2, POST_LOY_REP1, POST_LOY_REP2,
    sgrna_LFC, sgrna_FDR,
    Essential
  ) %>%
  arrange(Gene, sgrna_LFC)

cat(sprintf("sgRNA summary table: %d sgRNAs x %d columns\n", nrow(sgrna_summary), ncol(sgrna_summary)))
cat("\nColumn names:\n")
cat(paste(names(sgrna_summary), collapse = "\n"))

# Show summary
cat("\n\n===== sgRNA SUMMARY =====\n")
table(sgrna_summary$Essential) %>% print()
```

## 10.4 Export to Excel

```{r module10-export-excel}
cat("===== EXPORTING TO EXCEL =====\n\n")

# Create workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()

# Add Gene Summary sheet
addWorksheet(wb, "Gene_Summary")
writeData(wb, "Gene_Summary", gene_summary)

# Format header
header_style <- createStyle(
  textDecoration = "bold",
  fgFill = "#4472C4",
  fontColour = "white",
  halign = "center"
)
addStyle(wb, "Gene_Summary", header_style, rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(gene_summary), gridExpand = TRUE)

# Auto-width columns
setColWidths(wb, "Gene_Summary", cols = 1:ncol(gene_summary), widths = "auto")

# Add sgRNA Summary sheet
addWorksheet(wb, "sgRNA_Summary")
writeData(wb, "sgRNA_Summary", sgrna_summary)

# Format header
addStyle(wb, "sgRNA_Summary", header_style, rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(sgrna_summary), gridExpand = TRUE)

# Auto-width columns
setColWidths(wb, "sgRNA_Summary", cols = 1:ncol(sgrna_summary), widths = "auto")

# Save workbook
excel_output <- file.path(results_dir, "ht1080_loy_screen_summary.xlsx")
saveWorkbook(wb, excel_output, overwrite = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("Excel file saved: %s\n", excel_output))
cat(sprintf("  - Tab 1 (Gene_Summary): %d rows x %d columns\n", nrow(gene_summary), ncol(gene_summary)))
cat(sprintf("  - Tab 2 (sgRNA_Summary): %d rows x %d columns\n", nrow(sgrna_summary), ncol(sgrna_summary)))
```

**Module 10 Complete.** Summary Excel file exported to `results/ht1080_loy_screen_summary.xlsx`.
